results.summary: Set on the ground floor of Crusader Mill, this one-bedroom apartment pairs industrial heritage with carefully balanced modern design. Part of Capital & Centric’s renowned development, the Grade II-listed mill was reimagined by architects Shedkm into a considered collection of apartments arranged around a tranquil, residents-only courtyard. Behind its red-brick façade, the home retains original mill features, offering a characterful and well-proportioned living space within one of Manchester’s most dynamic emerging neighbourhoods. The Building Built in 1840, Crusader Mill was once at the heart of Manchester’s textile machinery industry, contributing to the city’s ‘Cottonopolis’ identity. Today, it stands as a thoughtful redevelopment where industrial heritage is carefully preserved and complemented by contemporary architectural interventions. Original elements are set alongside modern additions such as steel-framed access bridges, glazed lifts, and the scheme’s distinctive yellow insertions. At the centre of the development, a landscaped courtyard provides a calm shared space, with planting, seating, and communal areas designed for residents to gather and unwind. A 24-hour concierge service and secure cycle storage further support modern city living. The Space The entrance leads into a hallway, where engineered oak flooring runs underfoot and continues throughout the apartment. The double bedroom is positioned to the left. Further along, concealed storage is neatly integrated before the plan opens into the main living space. Here, an open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area is defined by exposed brickwork and retained timber beams overhead, reinforcing the building’s industrial origins. Two large arched powder-coated aluminium windows draw natural light into the space, giving the room a strong architectural identity. The kitchen is arranged along one wall, with integrated appliances and a mix of overhead and base cabinetry providing practical storage, while the layout allows for clearly defined zones for dining and living. The bathroom is finished in a contemporary palette, with a walk-in shower framed by black vertical stack tiling, alongside a vanity shelf with storage and a heated towel rail. The Area Crusader Mill sits within Piccadilly East, directly adjacent to Ancoats — now one of Manchester’s most sought-after neighbourhoods. Together, this part of the city forms a connected urban quarter, where independent cafés, restaurants, and cultural spaces are all within easy reach, spanning Ancoats, the Northern Quarter, Kampus, and New Islington. Piccadilly East offers a similar quality of architecture and lifestyle, with a slightly quieter, more emerging character. Recent additions such as Café Cotton at nearby Neptune Mill reflect this shift, contributing to a growing mix of independent food and drink alongside established destinations including Freight Island and Ducie Street Warehouse. Within a 10-minute walk, Mayfield Park provides green open space, offering a contrast to the surrounding urban fabric and a place to pause within the city. The area continues to evolve, with ongoing investment shaping Piccadilly East into an increasingly established part of Manchester. Nearby Mayfield is already taking form, introducing new public spaces, workplaces, and amenities that further connect this part of the city. Manchester Piccadilly Train Station is approximately five minutes on foot, offering direct trains to London Euston in just over two hours and Metrolink connections across the city region. The principal employment districts of NOMA, Spinningfields and the Oxford Road Corridor are all easily accessible. Motorway connections via the M56, M60 and M62 are convenient, with Manchester Airport approximately 25 minutes by car. results.summary: Briarwood - An exceptionally handsome five-bedroom period residence extending to an impressive 2,375 square feet, offering a rare opportunity to acquire a home of both character and versatility. Rich in original features and beautifully maintained throughout, this substantial property simply must be viewed internally to be fully appreciated. Upon entering, a welcoming vestibule leads into an inviting 21-foot hallway, setting the tone for the space and charm that continues throughout. The front living room is a delightful setting, enhanced by a walk-in bay window and an array of period details that create a warm and refined atmosphere. To the rear, a generously proportioned lounge provides ample space for freestanding furnishings, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The breakfast kitchen is equally impressive, fitted with contemporary eye and base level units and centred around a stylish shaped breakfast bar, perfect for informal dining. A practical utility room, complete with additional storage, offers direct access to the rear garden. The lower ground floor represents a truly outstanding feature of this home. The chambers provide good head height, and are currently utilized as a fantastic cinema room which boasts a fitted projector, gymnasium, rear chamber ideal for storage and has a handy door which gives external access to the rear gardens. A handy W.C with a fitted sink, can also be found. Ascending the beautiful original staircase, the split-level first floor reveals three well-appointed bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from full-width, floor-to-ceiling wardrobes and a stylish en-suite shower room fitted with a modern three-piece suite. A further contemporary family bathroom serves the remaining rooms on this level. A second staircase leads to the upper floor, where two additional bedrooms offer excellent head height and are flooded with natural light via Velux windows. The front bedroom also enjoys the luxury of its own modern en-suite. Throughout the property, characterful details such as ceiling coving and original pine doors sit alongside practical modern upgrades, including a contemporary central heating system and high-quality windows, ensuring comfort without compromising on style. Externally, the home is equally appealing. A charming frontage, enclosed by a low brick wall with wrought iron detailing, creates an attractive first impression. To the rear, the property enjoys a secluded low maintenance garden space along with off-road parking for two vehicles, accessible via a service alley from either Halesden Road or Orthes Grove. A fitted car charging point can also be found. Situated within a highly sought-after area of Heaton Chapel, Briarwood is ideally positioned close to a variety of local amenities, popular eateries, green spaces, and excellent transport links, including easy access to Manchester City Centre and nearby train services. This is a home that effortlessly combines space, character, and location, making it perfectly suited for growing families seeking something truly special. Situated within this popular purpose-built development, on Edge Lane and within walking distance to the centre of Chorlton with all its local amenities. Close to the Metrolink station on Wilbraham Road and good bus routes on your doorstep. This well-planned apartment consists of; a communal entrance hallway with stairs and a lift leading to all floors, a private entrance hallway, one double bedroom, a useful storage cupboard, a three-piece shower room, a spacious lounge and a fitted kitchen. The apartment benefits from electric storage heaters, a lift to all floors, 24-hour emergency care line response system, a communal lounge and kitchen area, use of a communal double guest bedroom (at a small cost) and a site house manager, communal mature lawned gardens to the rear aspect and off-road parking to the front aspect. Externally - To the front aspect there is resident and guest’s car parking. CCTV to the front and rear aspect of the property. To the rear of the property there are well maintained communal gardens. We will receive some of the fee taken by Lifetime Legal to compensate for its role in the provision of these checks. Ideally located within the catchment area of reputable schools, it also benefits from excellent transport links and a range of local amenities close by. results.summary: This charming extended semi-detached property is ideally located on a popular road near Fog Lane Park, just a stone's throw from Didsbury Village. Modernised throughout, this home offers a perfect blend of contemporary design and spacious living, making it ideal for families or professionals seeking a stylish and convenient location. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by a large, welcoming hallway that leads into a stunning reception room. With expansive windows, an electric fireplace, and elegant herringbone-style flooring, this room provides an inviting and bright space to relax. The ground floor also features a generous open-plan kitchen with a central island, Velux windows, and bifolding doors that open out onto the enclosed rear garden, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. Additionally, there is a modern downstairs W.C. conveniently located under the stairs in the hallway. Upstairs, the property offers three well-proportioned bedrooms—two double rooms and a single bedroom—along with a modern family bathroom. The added dormer loft extension, completed to building regulations with full sign-off, provides an additional double bedroom with an en-suite shower room and ample storage, offering further versatility and comfort. To the rear of the property, the bifolding doors open onto a composite decking area, perfect for outdoor entertaining or unwinding in privacy. The well-maintained garden includes an easy-care artificial lawn and Indian stone patio, ideal for those who enjoy spending time outdoors. The property also benefits from a small front garden and a driveway for one car, set back from the main road to offer additional curb appeal and a peaceful environment. The location couldn't be better, with Didsbury Village and Fog Lane Park just a short distance away. The area offers a wide range of local amenities, including shops, bars, supermarkets, and restaurants, as well as top-rated schools and excellent transport links. With easy access to Princess Parkway, Kingsway, the M60 ring road, and local hospitals, this property is perfect for both city commuters and families alike. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this wonderful property your home in one of Didsbury’s most sought-after areas. Call the Bridgfords office in Didsbury today to arrange your viewing! This method of auction requires both parties to complete the transaction within 56 days of the draft contract for sale being received by the buyers solicitor. results.summary: Are you looking for beautiful high level apartment with recently upgraded kitchen in the vibrant, Media City area of Salford Quays, then look no further. Situated on Pink, this wonderful home is at the heart of the vastly regenerated area of Manchester and bustling metropolis of Media, Education, Entertainment, Restaurants Bars and Retail. This 16th floor apartment is one of the larger styles in the development and has been upgraded recently adding to its desirability. On entry to the building you find a large communal room with private letterboxes and an additional security door to the inner hallway. Here a pair of lifts can be found to take you to the 16th floor. As you enter the apartment itself, a large spacious entrance hallway greets you with laminate flooring and storage cupboard. Doors from here lead to all the other accommodation. On your right, a door leads to the lovely open plan living area. At one end of the room there is a recently installed modern grey matt kitchen with an array of wall and base units with complimentary work surfaces. There are also integral chrome Smeg appliances. This kitchen opens up to a space for dining and a lounge area. There are patio doors to the Juliet balcony with views both left and right. This room in excess of 25ft in length provides a great entertaining area. There are two good sized double bedrooms with en-suite shower room to one of these. This is ideal for those buyers who are looking to buy to let or those who are also looking to buy and sublet a room for extra income. The en-suite is a shower room with mains fed shower. The family bathroom completes the accommodation with a three piece suite with bath with shower over. This accommodation is available to be rented with the furnishings included, The Media city area of the Quays is buzzing at all hours of the day. Within 1 minute walk there are a selection of restaurants and bars and there are further a mere 5 mins walk at the Lowry outlet village. The culture in the area can be found at the Lowry Theatre, which shows many plays, musicals and comedy shows throughout the year. Across the water is also the Imperial war museum. Only a 1 minute walk also takes you to the tram stop providing access to the city centre and access to the city's vast tram network. However if you don't wish to take the Tram there is a fantastic bus network also. Viewing is essential to see what this wonderful home has to offer. results.summary: This outstanding four-bedroom period home on The Drive offers a rare blend of timeless character and contemporary comfort. Thoughtfully renovated by the current owners, it showcases beautifully restored features alongside modern enhancements, creating a home that feels both luxurious and warmly lived-in. Set just off Bury New Road, this charming collection of period properties enjoys a wonderfully private setting, and this particular home stands out for its elegant finish and careful attention to detail throughout. A long, welcoming driveway leads past neatly kept lawns, setting the tone before you even step inside. The attractive bay-fronted façade immediately catches the eye, while the pride of ownership along the street adds to the appeal. Upon entering, the main hallway makes a striking first impression, with restored floorboards, high ceilings and a flowing layout that conveys real grandeur. This impressive entrance leads seamlessly into the main lounge and dining area, creating a superb space for both everyday living and entertaining. The family kitchen is equally inviting, thoughtfully designed with practical living in mind. Featuring double cooking facilities, excellent worktop space and plentiful storage, it also boasts an informal dining area-perfect for relaxed family meals or a morning coffee. Adding even more versatility, the basement has been transformed into a comfortable and functional room, ideal for use as a home office, playroom or creative workspace. On the first floor, you’ll find two generous double bedrooms, each complete with its own en suite. The master bedroom also benefits from large fitted wardrobes, offering brilliant storage without compromising the light, spacious feel. The top floor provides two further bedrooms and a shared bathroom, making it an excellent layout for families or visiting guests. Altogether, this is a beautifully renovated family home in an exceptionally sought-after location—combining period charm, contemporary style and well-planned living space. results.summary: This beautifully presented three bedroom semi detached house offers a perfect blend of contemporary comfort and practical living, ideal for families or professionals seeking a spacious and welcoming home. Upon entering, you are greeted by a bright and airy hallway that leads to the heart of the property, where an expansive open plan kitchen, dining and lounge area creates an inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is generously proportioned with modern fittings and ample storage, while the dining area comfortably accommodates a large table. Double patio doors allow natural light to flood the room and create a seamless connection to the outdoors, enhancing the sense of space. A separate living room area provides an additional relaxing space, thoughtfully designed with large front facing windows that further maximise natural light throughout the home. Upstairs, three well proportioned bedrooms offer versatile accommodation, each benefiting from neutral décor and practical layouts, making them easy to personalise. The principal bedroom provides a peaceful retreat, while the additional bedrooms are ideal for children, guests or a home office. A modern three piece family bathroom completes the upper floor, finished with contemporary fixtures and fittings. Further benefits include quality flooring throughout, ample storage options, and a garage providing additional storage space. The property is superbly positioned on Ponsonby Road, within walking distance of Stretford Marina, Trafford Park Train Station, Stretford Mall and the Stretford Metrolink. Chorlton is only a short 5–10 minute drive away, while nearby Chester Road offers direct access to Old Trafford. The property also sits within an excellent catchment area for local schools and provides a short journey into Manchester city centre. Excellent public transport links serve surrounding areas including The Trafford Centre, while the M60 motorway is easily accessible for commuters. This is an exceptional home in a highly sought after location and early viewing is strongly recommended. Doors open out onto a generous rear garden, which also benefits from convenient driveway access. To the first floor, a spacious landing leads to three bedrooms and a family bathroom. While some updating is required, the home boasts beautiful period features throughout, providing the perfect canvas for a new owner to blend original charm with modern design. This is an ideal purchase for families or buyers seeking a property with character, space, and outstanding potential in one of South Manchester’s most desirable neighbourhoods. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional. The amount you pay depends on: • when you bought the property • how much you paid for it • whether you’re eligible for relief or an exemption Rates for a single property You pay SDLT at these rates if, after buying the property, it is the only residential property you own. You will usually pay 5% on top of these rates if you own another residential property. results.summary: Tucked away on Senior Lane in Salford, this impressive three-storey Urban Splash townhouse offers over 1,500 sq ft of stylish and versatile living space, perfectly suited to modern urban lifestyles. The ground floor is designed with contemporary living in mind, featuring a spacious open-plan layout that seamlessly combines the living, dining, and kitchen areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Large windows invite plenty of natural light, while direct access to the rear garden creates a perfect indoor-outdoor flow. The property also benefits from a private driveway, adding convenience to its list of features. The second floor comprises two well-proportioned bedrooms, one of which enjoys access to a charming private balcony. This level is serviced by a modern three-piece family bathroom and is further enhanced by two handy storage cupboards. Occupying the entire top floor, the stunning principal suite is a true highlight of the home. This expansive open-plan space includes a generous sleeping area, a stylish ensuite bathroom, a dedicated vanity area, and a comfortable reception space. Beautiful vaulted ceilings add character and a sense of grandeur, while the flexible layout offers the option to divide the space into two separate bedrooms if desired. results.summary: Moston Lane East, New Moston Large Plot | Generous Garden | Substantial Garage | Private Parking | Three Bedroom Detached | Freehold This well-presented three-bedroom detached property from 1850 offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home that combines space, privacy and long-term potential within a well-connected and established residential location. The accommodation provides a well-balanced and practical layout, ideally suited to modern family living. The ground floor offers comfortable reception space alongside kitchen accommodation, with the addition of a conservatory that benefits from underfloor heating and an upgraded aluminium tiled roof, allowing it to be used comfortably throughout the year as an additional living or sitting area. To the first floor are three well-proportioned double bedrooms and a family bathroom, with all bedrooms offering generous proportions. Buyers are encouraged to refer to the floor plan to fully appreciate the size and layout of the accommodation. Being a detached home, the property benefits from an increased sense of privacy and separation, a feature highly sought after by buyers looking for a quieter and more independent living environment. The property is offered on a freehold basis, ensuring long-term ownership security and peace of mind. Externally, the home stands out with its generous plot, offering a beautifully maintained and notably larger than average garden for the area. This outdoor space is ideal for families, entertaining or those seeking a more spacious setting. A greenhouse is also in place with fitted water supply, enhancing practicality for gardening enthusiasts. The private and enclosed rear area provides a safe and secure environment, with gated access adding further peace of mind. A substantial detached garage, fully fitted with electricity, provides excellent additional space for storage, workshop use or secure parking. Private off-road parking further complements the property. The home also benefits from a cellar, offering useful additional storage space. From an efficiency and long-term cost perspective, the property is equipped with eight privately owned 250-watt solar panels. These operate under a favourable feed-in tariff arrangement, with approximately ten years remaining, providing ongoing financial benefit. A recently installed inverter with an expected lifespan of approximately ten years supports the system. In addition, the boiler has been replaced within the last three years and is regularly serviced. The property further benefits from direct optical fibre broadband installed into the home, providing fast and reliable internet connectivity, ideal for modern working and streaming requirements. The main roof is in excellent condition, with ridge tiles having been recently repaired and benefiting from a lifetime guarantee. The property offers further potential, subject to the necessary planning permissions. Historically, there was planning approval for an additional three-bedroom dwelling on part of the land (now expired), which may present an opportunity for future development, making this an attractive prospect for buyers seeking long-term flexibility. The property is ideally positioned to benefit from everything modern day living requires. In terms of connectivity, the home is well served by frequent bus routes along Moston Lane, providing access into Manchester city centre, Middleton, Oldham and surrounding areas. Moston railway station is within walking distance, and Failsworth Metrolink tram stop can be reached in approximately 15 minutes on foot, offering further convenient access into Manchester city centre and beyond. The area is particularly well suited to families, with New Moston Primary School located on Moston Lane East itself, along with additional schooling options including Moston Lane Community Primary School and St Matthew’s RC High School, all within close proximity. For outdoor and leisure activities, Broadhurst Park is nearby, providing open green space ideal for families, walking and recreation. A range of local shops, amenities and community facilities are also easily accessible, supporting convenient day-to-day living. This property will appeal to a wide range of buyers. Families will value the generous bedroom sizes, outdoor space and proximity to schools. Buyers looking to move up the ladder will recognise the opportunity to secure a detached home with land and long-term potential, while investors or developers may be drawn to the potential for future development, subject to planning. Detached homes offering this level of space, outdoor area, parking and future potential are rarely available in this location. Early viewing is strongly advised. MCC250465/2 Summary This landmark Grade II listed building was previously the home of the Cooperative Printing Society, and has in recent years been sympathetically and imaginatively converted to create striking 'New York style' apartments successfully blending original features with luxury modern touches. The communal areas evoke the building's industrial heritage, with exposed brick walls and stone floors. The Garden Level: Annex or Studio Potential Setting this property apart is the third reception room, located on a lower level and accessed independently from the front exterior. There is also a lift which connects this room to the main floor. This substantial space offers incredible flexibility and could be transformed into: A self-contained "granny flat" or teenager's annex. A professional home office or creative studio for those seeking a distinct separation between work and home life. A private gymnasium or cinema room with direct garden access. Residents are just moments away from the vibrant independent scene of Prestwich Village, the expansive greenery of Heaton Park, and elite transport links including the Metrolink and M60 motorway network. results.summary: Completing 2027. Positioned alongside a new community park, Collyhurst Village is renewing the community spirit and pride of this historic and inspiring neighbourhood. Its unique location means you can enjoy the peaceful setting and open green space of the Irk Valley, but with the high-quality retail and leisure offer of Manchester City Centre only 20 minutes' walk away. Collyhurst is an ideal place to call home for families due to the tight knit community and choice of schools in the area. The location is well served by public transport with several bus and rail routes to and from the city centre. Collyhurst Village is one of the first phases of Victoria North, the North of England's biggest regeneration project. Victoria North is set to create 15,000 new homes across 155 hectares and seven neighbourhoods over the next 20 years, helping with the shortfall in housing in Manchester. The redevelopment project will create better-connected public spaces, new and improved transport links, and more homes, parks and retail spaces for the city's growing population. results.summary: A stunning and larger than expected three bedroom end terrace with parking, a garage and lovely gardens, perfect for anyone looking to upsize! EPC : D A unique opportunity for families, those looking to upsize and first time buyers with this exceptionally well-appointed, larger than average THREE BEDROOM end terrace house on the ever sought after Parkfield Road North in New Moston. Boasting beautiful modern decor throughout complemented by quality fittings, the property offers remarkably spacious living throughout and is READY TO MOVE INTO. The property opens into a welcoming entrance hallway with a large yet cosy lounge to the right. There is then a fantastic open-plan kitchen/dining room at the rear which affords ample worktop and cupboard space with integrated appliances including fridge/freezer, hob and oven plus plenty of space for dining and double doors opening onto the garden. There is also access from the kitchen to a handy store cupboard beneath the stairs. To the first floor there is a spacious landing leading through to three superbly proportioned double bedrooms with a contemporary three piece bathroom at the rear completing the accommodation. A highly popular location, prospective buyers will find superb commuter links right on your doorstep with the nearest Junctions for the M60 motorway and the nearby Metrolink station within 1 mile providing superb links throughout North Manchester. There are well-regarded schools within walking distance including New Moston and Whitegate End Primaries within walking distance. From Broadway, turn left onto Moston Lane East then take your 2nd left onto Hawthorn Road. Continue to the bottom then turn right onto Parkfield Road North and the property will be on your right. All mains services are understood to be available. results.summary: Hyde Estates are delighted to offer this extended, semi detached family home for sale. Featuring four double bedrooms and three reception rooms the property offers spacious accommodation throughout. Benefitting from Freehold title and gardens to the front and rear, complete with driveway providing off street parking and an integral garage which can be utilised to suit. Offered with no onward chain. Situated on Woodhill Drive which can be accessed from both Scholes Lane and Bury New Road (A56) with excellent links to both Prestwich and Manchester City Centre and their abundance of amenities. Conveniently located within walking distance of Sedgley Village and Heaton Park. Accommodation - Briefly comprising; porch, entrance hall with stairs to first floor and understairs store cupboard, guest wc with white suite of wc and washbasin, frosted window and tiled splashback. Front facing lounge with bay window and fitted display cabinets fully opening to the dining room which has a seperate door directly to the kitchen and part glazed doors opening to a further reception room which can be used to suite, feature fireplace and patio doors out to paved patio, ideal for outside dining in the summer months. The dual aspect, eat in kitchen has ample space for a dining table and chairs and is fitted with a range of wall and base with contrasting worktops, 2 x inset sink units and mixer taps with tiled splashbacks. Two integrated electric ovens, four ring gas hob with extractor hood and space for freestanding fridge/freezer. Space and plumbing for two dishwashers. From the kitchen is a seperate utility room housing the boiler and providing space and plumbing for a washing machine. Door to rear garden. From the first floor landing are four double bedrooms, a family bathroom and seperate shower room. The front facing main bedroom features a bay window and wall of fitted robes, with the second bedroom including the same key features. The third double room is located above the garage and in the extended part of the property and has ample space for a freestanding bedroom furniture. Smaller fourth bedroom with laminate flooring, fitted robes and space for a double bed. The family bathroom is fully tiled, with two frosted windows and features a three piece white suite of; wc, vanity unit and bath with mains operated shower and shower screen, heated chrome towel rail. Seperate shower room with three piece suite of; wc, washbasin and shower cubicle. Tiled splashbacks, chrome towel rail and extractor fan. Room Measurements - Lounge: 14’ x 14’2" measured into bay Dining Room: 13’1" x 12’8” Reception Room: 11’8" x 10’4” Eat in Kitchen: 17’3" x 10’ Bedroom 1: 14’10" x 14’1” measured into bay Bedroom 2: 15’4’’ x 12’6” measured into bay Bedroom 3: 13’11" x 8’1" plus recess Bedroom 4: 10’9" x 7’5" at extremes Bathroom: 9'1” x 5’9” Shower Room: 6’8” x 4’11" Garage - Integral garage with up and over garage door, complete with electrical power and access door to rear. Currently used for additional storage. Gardens - The front garden features a sloping driveway and steps to the front door and a well tended lawn with shrubbery borders. To the rear of the property is a private paved patio accessed via patio doors from the rear reception room, whilst a further paved patio area leads to the rear of the garage. Steps adjacent to the back door access a lawned area with a further set of steps meandering their way up towards the back of the sloping rear garden. Parking - Driveway to the front of the property provides off street parking. Additional Information - The property is fully alarmed and benefits gas central heating and uPVC double glazed windows. Tenure - We understand from the Vendor that the property is FREEHOLD. Council Tax - Bury Council, Band E. Fixtures & Fittings - Carpets, curtains, and light fittings available by negotiation. We have not tested any appliances or electrical items. Viewings - All viewings to be arranged via Hyde Estate and Letting Agents . While we make every effort to ensure the accuracy of the details, we strongly recommend that interested parties view the property in person to confirm the property’s condition and suitability for their specific requirements. results.summary: Situated on the second floor of the highly regarded Mansion House, this beautifully presented two-bedroom apartment offers stylish, low-maintenance living in a peaceful waterside setting, with attractive views over New Islington Marina. Extending to approximately 753 sq ft, the apartment is thoughtfully designed to maximise both space and natural light. The heart of the home is a generous open-plan living and dining area, where large windows frame the marina outlook and create a bright, welcoming environment, ideal for relaxing at home or entertaining guests. The kitchen is finished to a modern specification with integrated appliances and clean, contemporary cabinetry, blending seamlessly into the living space to create a sociable and functional layout. Both bedrooms are comfortable doubles, with the principal bedroom providing a calm retreat, while the second bedroom offers excellent flexibility for use as a guest room, home office or dressing room, particularly appealing for buyers working from home. Mansion House is known for its distinctive architecture, energy-efficient construction and strong community feel, making it especially popular with owner occupiers seeking a modern home in a well-connected yet tranquil location. Residents enjoy immediate access to scenic canal-side walks and green spaces, while the vibrant restaurants, cafés and independent shops of Cutting Room Square are just a short stroll away. New Islington Metrolink is also within easy walking distance, providing convenient connections across the city. This is a fantastic opportunity to secure a stylish waterside home in one of Manchester's most desirable neighbourhoods, perfectly suited to professionals, couples or downsizers looking for quality, design and location. PROPERTY DESCRIPTION Entrance Hall Welcoming entrance hallway providing access to all principal rooms. Finished with contemporary tiled flooring and useful built-in storage cupboard. Kitchen 13'2 x 10'0 A spacious and well-appointed kitchen featuring a generous range of base and full-height units in a modern white finish, complemented by quartz work surfaces and matching splashback. Integrated appliances include a Bosch electric oven, four-ring hob with extractor over, fridge freezer and dishwasher. The kitchen flows naturally into the main living space, creating a sociable and practical layout. Living Area 18'4 x 9'2 An impressive corner-positioned living space, beautifully enhanced by distinctive wood-panelled walls and ceiling, creating a warm and characterful feel. Three tall windows allow for excellent natural light, while double doors open onto two separate balconies, both enjoying attractive views over New Islington Marina - a rare and highly desirable feature. Bedroom One 13'5 x 9'9 A generous double bedroom featuring stylish wood-panelled detailing and a large window providing good natural light. A comfortable and relaxing principal bedroom. Bedroom Two 8'2 x 9'4 A well-proportioned second bedroom offering flexibility for use as a guest room, home office or dressing room, ideal for modern living. Shower Room 4'11 x 6'6 Modern shower room fitted with a walk-in double shower, wall-mounted wash hand basin with fitted cabinetry and feature mirror, and heated towel rail. Finished with contemporary tiling. WC 4'11 x 4'7 Separate WC with wall-mounted fittings, integrated storage and heated towel rail. results.summary: 4 Bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, over 3 storeys with parking for two cars. Ideally located for commuting to Manchester City Centre. A modern kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances, an island, and French doors to the garden. The dining room doubles up as a home office and a downstairs wc suits family use. The living room and main bathroom are at first floor level along with one bedroom and 3 further bedrooms and an ensuite are located on the second floor. Being Gas central heated and double glazed this home is well insulated and has a fully boarded loft for storage. The secure patio garden also has a lawned area and secure fencing and a gate providing access down a path back around the the front of the house. HALLWAY 6' 8" x 15' 8" (2.039m x 4.792m) Through the front door is a lovely light and bright hallway with plenty of space for coats and shoes and access to the dining room, kitchen and wc. There is also a small storage cupboard under the stairs. DINING ROOM 8' 4" x 15' 3" (2.55m x 4.65m) Currently used as a dining room the front reception room would also work as a home office or children's play room with plenty of natural light and warmth from the central heating. KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM 15' 8" x 10' 2" (4.786m x 3.121m) With fully fitted units, and integrated appliances the kitchen has an island unit providing seating and storage. Appliances include a dishwasher, washer/dryer, fridge/freezer and an electric oven and gas hob with extractor over. Access to the garden is via French doors leading out onto the patio. DOWNSTAIRS WC Tucked away under the stairs is a good sized wc room with a hand wash basin. LIVING ROOM 15' 7" x 10' 2" (4.774m x 3.122m) Located at the rear of the property the huge living room offers relaxing space for all the family or could be turned into another bedroom if the dining room was used as a lounge. FAMILY BATHROOM 8' 5" x 5' 6" (2.588m x 1.699m) A contemporary family bathroom means there'll be no morning rush-hour queues, and creates a harmonious dynamic for families, professionals, or anyone who values a bit of privacy and space. BEDROOM 3/ PLAYROOM 8' 6" x 9' 7" (2.6m x 2.943m) Currently used as a children's playroom this bedroom was previously used as a double bedroom and offers views out onto the woodland opposite. MASTER BEDROOM 8' 5" x 12' 9" (2.574m x 3.892m) The master bedroom is a tranquil retreat boasting an elegant en-suite bathroom and built-in wardrobes for effortless organisation. BEDROOM 2 8' 4" x 11' 3" (2.557m x 3.446m) Used as a nursery at the moment this double room looks out over the garden and has a wall of fitted wardrobes installed with sliding doors. BEDROOM 4 7' 0" x 7' 0" (2.139m x 2.143m) The smallest of the four bedrooms houses a single bed ideal as a guest room or children's bedroom or even a home study. EXTERIOR The front of the house has a driveway for one car and another parking space opposite which is listed on the land registry deeds belonging to this home. There is access to the rear down a pathway which runs behind the neighbouring property to the right. The garden has two patios with a path linking them making the most of the sunshine throughout the day. There is hardstanding for a shed and a luscious green lawn which is easy to maintain. Completed in 2020 by Salboy and built by Domis Construction, this striking community of 399 apartments and seven townhouses across three distinct towers is just a 15-minute walk from Manchester City Centre. This exquisite two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment, priced at £294,950 with stunning views over the River Irwell, is an ideal choice for homeowners seeking a chic riverside lifestyle and investors targeting high-yield opportunities in Salford’s thriving M5 postcode. For Homeowners A Stylish Riverside Retreat-Step into this beautifully presented seventh-floor, two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment, designed for contemporary elegance. The open-plan living area boasts high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a private balcony with breathtaking views of the River Irwell and Manchester’s skyline-perfect for entertaining or unwinding. The sleek kitchen features Magnet German-designed units, white granite worktops, glass splashbacks, and integrated appliances, including a fan oven, ceramic hob, extractor, dishwasher, fridge/freezer, and washer/dryer. Both double bedrooms are carpeted with built-in wardrobes, the master featuring an en-suite with a low-profile shower tray, contemporary tiling, and a chrome heated towel rail. A second Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a shower over bath completes the layout. Residents enjoy premium amenities: a 24/7 concierge, heated swimming pool, jacuzzi, sauna, state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, two cinema rooms, a solarium, roof terrace, and landscaped courtyard gardens with BBQ facilities. With Spinningfields’ dining (The Ivy, 20 Stories) and Salford University (6-minute walk) nearby, Local Crescent offers an unrivalled blend of luxury and convenience. For Investors A High-Return Riverside Gem Priced at £294,950, this two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment commands good rent- delivering gross yields up to 6% (net yields around 5% after service charges and ground rent. Fully furnished and in high demand, it’s a turnkey investment in Salford’s rejuvenated Crescent district, where property values are forecast to grow 29.4% by 2029 (Savills). Its prime location, opposite the River Irwell and close to Salford Central Station (0.5 miles), Manchester University, and Deansgate’s commercial hub, ensures strong tenant appeal for professionals, students, and sharers. The 250-year leasehold, EWS1 compliance, and extensive amenities-gym, pool, concierge, and secure bike storage-enhance its desirability for long-term or short-term lets. With on-site parking (available separately) and a vibrant community vibe, this apartment is a low-maintenance, high-return asset in Manchester’s booming rental market. Prime Location- Vibrant Lifestyle Located on Hulme Street, Local Crescent sits in Salford’s up-and-coming Crescent district, offering tranquil river views and easy access to Manchester’s cultural and commercial hubs. A 15-minute walk takes you to Spinningfields’ high-end dining, the Northern Quarter’s trendy bars, or Manchester Central’s events. Salford Crescent Station (0.7 miles) and Deansgate tram stops provide excellent connectivity, with Manchester Airport just 13 km away. The nearby River Irwell and surrounding parkland offer scenic walks, while local amenities like Salford Shopping Centre, restaurants, and cafés create a lively, self-contained community. The area’s ongoing regeneration, including restored historic buildings and new commercial developments, promises further growth in value and appeal. KITCHEN With a range of wall and base units in White with contrasting worktops over incorporating a one and a half stainless steel drainer sink unit with mixer taps. UPVC double glazed windows. Two light fittings. CONSERVATORY 10' 2" x 10' 5" (3.1m x 3.18m) With UPVC double glazed patio doors leading to the rear garden. Wooden flooring. LANDING With UPVC stained double glazed windows. Radiator. Light fitting. Access to all three bedrooms and the bathroom. BEDROOM ONE 11' 7" x 12' 1" (3.53m x 3.68m) With UPVC double glazed windows. Radiator. Centre light fitting. Range of fitted furniture. BEDROOM TWO 8' 6" x 10' 7" (2.59m x 3.23m) With UPVC double glazed windows. Radiator. Light fitting. Fitted wardrobes. BEDROOM THREE 7' 5" x 9' 5" (2.26m x 2.87m) With UPVC double glazed windows. Radiator. Light fitting. Fitted wardrobe. BATHROOM With a three piece suite in White comprising low level toilet, wash hand basin and bath. Contemporary rain shower over the bath. Tiling to the walls and flooring. UPVC frosted double glazed windows. White heated towel rail. Recess low voltage spotlights to the ceiling. LOFT 11' 5" x 12' 8" (3.48m x 3.86m) With pull down ladder. Velux window. Wooden flooring. results.summary: Positioned on one of the most desirable roads within the prestigious Heaton Manor Estate, The Oakwood is a beautifully presented four-bedroom detached home that offers both style and practicality. Built in 2016 and offered for sale with no onward chain, this impressive property provides bright, balanced living accommodation across two thoughtfully designed floors. An internal viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, condition, and quality this home has to offer. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by an entrance hallway that immediately sets the tone for the home’s light and inviting atmosphere. A convenient ground floor W.C. sits just off the hallway, ideal for guests. The main living room provides a bright and comfortable space with generous room for freestanding furniture, making it perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. The heart of the home is undoubtedly the stunning 23-foot open plan dining kitchen. Designed with modern living in mind, the kitchen features contemporary fitted units complemented by stylish work surfaces and a range of integrated appliances, including a fridge freezer, dishwasher, double oven, and hob. The dining area creates a sociable space for family meals and gatherings, while French doors open directly onto the rear garden, allowing natural light to flood the room and providing a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. A separate utility room offers additional practicality and storage. A single staircase leads to the first-floor landing where four well-proportioned bedrooms can be found. The principal bedroom benefits from its own en-suite facilities, providing a private and comfortable retreat. The remaining bedrooms are served by a modern family bathroom, finished to a high standard. Throughout the property the décor is immaculate, reflecting the care taken since its construction. Further benefits include uPVC double glazed windows and a modern central heating system, ensuring both comfort and energy efficiency throughout the year. Externally, the property continues to impress. A driveway provides convenient off-road parking and leads to an integral garage accessed via an up-and-over door. Mature hedge borders frame the front approach, with a flagged pathway guiding visitors to the entrance. To the rear, the property boasts attractive gardens laid mainly to lawn, alongside flagged patio areas that create the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Positioned on a convenient section of the development, Harrow Drive is ideal for all local amenities including Heaton Moor village and transport links which include Heaton Chapel train station. The property is also zoned for reputable Primary and Secondary Schools. results.summary: The Property A modern and stylish two-bedroom apartment located within the highly desirable Local Crescent development on Hulme Street, offering contemporary city living with excellent convenience and connectivity. The apartment features a bright living room, a fitted kitchen with modern fixtures, two well-proportioned bedrooms, and a bathroom, with the main bedroom benefiting from an en-suite, providing a comfortable and functional layout ideal for first-time buyers, professionals, or investors. Residents of the development enjoy an enviable urban lifestyle in one of Salford’s most sought-after locations, just a short walk from Manchester city centre and major transport hubs such as Salford Central and Salford Crescent train stations and fantastic bus routes Within walking distance you’ll find a wide range of everyday conveniences including supermarkets such as Co-op, Home Bargains, and Sainsbury’s, plus cafés, gyms and other local shops. For leisure and nightlife, the area offers numerous pubs and restaurants, including The Black Friar, Eagle Inn, The New Oxford, The Kings Arms, and Matchstick Man — all within easy reach for relaxed evenings out. You’re also close to vibrant dining and leisure destinations at MediaCityUK, such as The Alchemist MediaCityUK and Harvester Quayside Mediacityuk, and atmospheric local pubs like Old Pint Pot and Atmosphere. The position of the apartment also puts cultural attractions like Peel Park and Salford Museum and Art Gallery within easy reach, offering residents green space and cultural experiences close to home. Perfectly positioned for city centre living with excellent amenities on the doorstep, this apartment combines modern living with accessibility and lifestyle appeal. A security deposit of at least one month’s rent is required. Rent is to be paid one month in advance. It is the tenant’s responsibility to insure any personal possessions. Payment of all utilities including water rates or metered supply and Council Tax is the responsibility of the tenant in most cases. DID260100/2 Spacious and Stylish One-Bedroom Apartment – Perfect for First-Time Buyers Occupying the first floor of an attractive period conversion, this beautifully presented one-bedroom apartment offers far more space than typically expected—making it an excellent first step onto the property ladder. Bathed in natural light thanks to its large double-glazed windows and high ceilings, the apartment boasts a generous layout that includes an additional room ideal for a home office, dressing area or walk-in storage. Stylish wooden flooring flows throughout the main areas, and the entire home is finished to a very high standard. . Ideal for a young couple or individual seeking a home with character and room to grow, this property also benefits from a modern kitchen with space to dine, feature lighting, and access to a shared garden and cellar storage. The property is warmed by a gas combination boiler and comes with off-road parking to the front. Early internal viewing is highly recommended. Communal Entrance Secure communal entry leads into a well-kept, carpeted hallway with stairs rising to the first floor and the apartment’s private front door. Entrance Hall A welcoming entrance hall with quality wooden flooring and ceiling light, offering access to the lounge, kitchen, bedroom, and study. Living Room 5.3m x 3.8m (17' 5" x 12' 6") A bright and airy main reception room with two large windows drawing in natural light. Features include stylish alcove shelving, dual-mode feature lighting, TV and power points, radiator, and beautiful wood flooring continued from the hallway. The generous proportions offer more space than is typical in most one-bedroom flats—ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Kitchen 3.7m x 3.5m (12' 2" x 11' 6") A modern and functional kitchen with ample space for dining. Fitted with matching wall and base units, complementary worktops, tiled splashbacks, and a stainless steel sink with swan-neck tap. Integrated appliances include oven, hob, extractor, and microwave, with space for a fridge-freezer. Two windows provide excellent natural light, and the wooden flooring adds a warm, contemporary finish. Bedroom 3.7m x 3.7m (12' 2" x 12' 2") A generously sized double bedroom with space for a large bed and wardrobes. Includes a double-glazed window, radiator, and ceiling light. Study/Dressing Room 2.4m x 2.2m (7' 10" x 7' 3") This useful additional room offers great versatility—ideal as a home office, dressing area, or extra storage. Features include a window, wooden flooring, ceiling light, power points and radiator. It also gives access to the bathroom. Bathroom 2.9m x 1.4m (9' 6" x 4' 7") A sleek and modern bathroom suite with full-height tiling, panelled bath with overhead mixer shower and screen, low-level WC, and pedestal basin. Also includes a chrome heated towel rail, frosted window, extractor fan, and spot lighting. Outside To the front of the property is a driveway offering off-road parking. The rear garden is shared between residents and enjoys a pleasant open aspect backing onto allotments. Residents also have use of a cellar for secure storage, ideal for bikes and similar items. Leasehold & Charges Lease Term: 999 years from 24 June 1994 (approx. 970 years remaining) Ground Rent: £25 Service Charge: £70 (paid monthly) Council Tax Band A- Manchester City Council Chain Status Please be advised that this property is being offered for sale with No Onward Chain. The vendor does not require a related purchase to proceed, providing a streamlined and secure starting position for any prospective buyer. We outsource this check to a third party and a charge will apply. Ask the branch for further details. results.location: Alan Road, Heaton Moor, Stockport, SK4
results.summary: Having been thoughtfully extended and located on a highly desirable position just off Heaton Moor Road, this superb four double bedroom Emery-style detached home, presents an exceptional opportunity for growing families seeking both space and style. Extending to an impressive 1776 square feet, the home is immaculately presented throughout and arranged over two generous floors, offering a seamless blend of modern comfort and elegant design. Early viewing is highly recommended to avoid disappointment. Upon entering, a welcoming vestibule opens into a commanding hallway that immediately sets the tone, drawing the eye through to the beautifully maintained rear gardens beyond. Practicality meets refinement here, with convenient understairs storage and a well-appointed downstairs W.C enhancing the functionality of this particular space. The spacious 19-foot living room provides a warm and inviting setting, centred around a striking ‘Chilli Pegasus’ multi-fuel fire with an exquisite hand-carved Yorkshire stone surround. French doors lead through to a secondary lounge area, ideal as a snug or dedicated space for teenagers, perfect for relaxing or enjoying film nights in comfort. To the rear, a stunning full-width single-storey extension creates the true heart of the home. The open-plan dining and kitchen area has been designed with both everyday living and entertaining in mind. The dining space is bathed in natural light from bi-fold doors and Velux windows, offering ample room for freestanding furniture while creating a seamless connection to the outdoors. The bespoke handmade kitchen is equally impressive, featuring a range of luxurious eye and base-level units complemented by quality work surfaces and a central island with breakfast seating. Integrated appliances, including a Rangemaster five-ring gas hob, enhance both the practicality and visual appeal of this exceptional space. Finishing touches such as zoned hidden lighting, underfloor heating, inset spotlights and premium flooring further elevate the overall experience, making this area both stylish and highly functional. This room again is flooded with natural light from a matching set of bi-fold doors and Velux windows. A turning staircase leads to the first-floor landing, where contemporary doors open to four generously sized double bedrooms. The accommodation is served by a modern shower room with a sleek three-piece suite, alongside an additional separate family bathroom complete with feature wooden panelling, a freestanding bath and twin vanity sinks, offering a luxurious retreat for relaxation. Additional features include uPVC double glazing throughout and a modern gas central heating system supported by a separate power tank, delivering consistent three-bar pressure for enhanced performance. Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front, formal gardens and a driveway provide off-road parking and lead to a 19-foot integral garage with an electric up-and-over door. A wooden side gate offers access to the rear gardens, where a beautifully maintained lawn is framed by mature planting, creating a private and tranquil setting. This secluded outdoor space is perfectly suited for alfresco dining and entertaining, completing what is truly a standout family home. Situated in the heart of Heaton Moor, within equal distance of both Moor Top, local shops and amenities and the fashionable bars and restaurants around Shaw Road and just a 10-minute walk to Heaton Chapel train station, the location is just one of the many great selling features. results.summary: Situated in a peaceful residential close, this charming mid-terrace home on Derwent Close offers an ideal balance of comfort and convenience. Tucked between the vibrant communities of Chorlton and Didsbury, the property benefits from a highly desirable location with easy access to major motorway networks, making commuting straightforward. The area is particularly popular with families, thanks to its excellent local schools, green spaces, and a strong sense of community. Upon approach, the home is set behind a private front garden, mainly laid to lawn, with a pathway guiding you to the entrance. Inside, the welcoming hallway leads to a generously sized living room on the left, featuring a front-facing window that fills the space with natural light, along with a charming cast iron fireplace surround that creates a cosy focal point. An archway seamlessly connects the living area to the kitchen diner, which is thoughtfully fitted with a range of base and eye-level units, complemented by wood work surfaces and tiled splashbacks. The kitchen also offers space for appliances, a breakfast bar, and ample room for a dining table and chairs, making it perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Patio doors open out to the rear garden, enhancing the indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs, the property offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, including two spacious doubles and a good-sized single, ideal for a growing family, home office, or guest room. Open archway leading to the Kitchen. Frosted windows with Plantation shutters. TO THE OUTSIDE To the front of the property is a small stone pebbled garden which is enclosed from the public footpath by a dwarf brick built wall. Situated across the third and top floor of this purpose-built development in West Didsbury known as Jefferson apartments. A short stroll from Burton Road with its array of independent boutique shops, popular bars, restaurants and cafes and the Metrolink stations on The Parkway, Withington or Lapwing Lane, West Didsbury, providing direct access into the city centre, Media City and Didsbury Village. In brief the well planned apartment consists of; an entrance hall with useful storage cupboards, a W.C, two double bedrooms both benefitting from en-suites, an additional bedroom, and an open plan newly fitted kitchen/ living room. The kitchen benefits from a central island and access out onto the private balcony. The kitchen and en-suite both benefit from underfloor heating. Stairs leading to the first floor reveals a study, and a sizeable lounge with access out onto the impressive private terrace area with sweeping sky line views. The apartment benefits from electric heating, under floor heating, an intercom system, two private outdoor areas, and an allocated parking space. Externally - The Jefferson apartments are set within well maintained communal grounds, there is gated allocated parking, and the apartment benefits from a sizeable terrace. Financial Services - We believe that by introducing our clients to specialist advisors who provide simple, sensible, mortgage & protection advice we can help our clients make fully informed decisions giving them the confidence that they are getting the right deal from the start. Our partners are committed to offering a tailor-made personal and professional service and aim to exceed expectations on every level, specialising in finding the best mortgage & protection products to suit your particular needs. If you wish to take the opportunity to speak with our partner advisors at Bespoke Mortgage; Bridget and Mark can be reached on or Aml - (Anti-Money Laundering). - We are required by law and HMRC guidelines to carry out anti-money laundering checks on all those selling or buying a property. Whilst we retain responsibility for ensuring checks and any ongoing monitoring are carried out correctly, the initial checks are carried out on our behalf by Lifetime Legal who will contact you once you have agreed to instruct us in your sale or had an offer accepted on a property you wish to buy. The cost of these checks is £60 (incl. VAT), which covers the cost of obtaining relevant data and any manual checks and monitoring which might be required. This fee will need to be paid by you in advance of us publishing your property (in the case of a vendor) or issuing a memorandum of sale (in the case of a buyer), directly to Lifetime Legal, and is non-refundable. We will receive some of the fee taken by Lifetime Legal to compensate for its role in the provision of these checks. Stamp Duty Land Tax (Sdlt) - You usually pay Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) on increasing portions of the property price when you buy residential property, for example a house or flat. The amount you pay depends on: • when you bought the property • how much you paid for it • whether you’re eligible for relief or an exemption Rates for a single property You pay SDLT at these rates if, after buying the property, it is the only residential property you own. results.summary: An immaculately appointed three bedroom semi-detached perfect for families with a superb garden on driveway on a charming street a few miles from Manchester. EPC - D. Superbly presented inside and out, this three bedroom semi-detached house on Oakwood Avenue in New Moston is a must-view! Presented to a high standard by the current owners, the property boasts bright and neutral decor and is in a ready to move in condition making it an ideal buy for any first time buyers and family buyers alike. Internally, to the ground floor there is a welcoming entrance hallway leading into a large L-shaped lounge and dining area which leads through to a substantial conservatory which enjoys a proper roof for year-round enjoyment. Elsewhere to the ground floor there is a pleasant modern kitchen plus storage beneath the stairs. Upstairs, there are two good sized double bedrooms and a further single bedroom. There are local schools within walking distance including St Matthew's RC High School and New Moston Primary to name a couple plus local shops/supermarkets within easy reach. Lower Memorial Park can be accessed at the end of the street, which offers a bowling green, a modernised play area for children and boasts a beautiful walking space with pleasant surroundings. The nearby Broadway allows for easy access towards Chadderton/Oldham. results.summary: Set within the characterful Lincoln Place on Hulme Street, this beautifully airy duplex apartment offers a wonderful blend of period charm and practical modern living. Entered on the ground floor, it feels increasingly like a true one-bedroom apartment rather than a compact city pad, giving you that all-important sense of space and separation between living and sleeping. From the moment you step inside, you'll notice the features that make this home so appealing: high ceilings, large windows and an abundance of natural light that creates a calm, uplifting atmosphere throughout. The proportions are generous, with lovely period touches adding warmth and personality, while the all-electric set-up keeps things straightforward and low-maintenance. The reception room is an inviting place to unwind or entertain, with the airy feel and elegant detailing making it easy to style whether your taste is cosy and layered or clean and contemporary. A separate kitchen is a real bonus at this price point, keeping cooking and hosting nicely contained, and the separate bathroom adds everyday convenience and a more “proper home” layout. Practicalities are well catered for too, with an elevator in the building making coming and going that much easier, whether you're juggling shopping bags, commuting essentials, or simply want that added comfort day to day. With the home's duplex design, you can enjoy a clear divide between social space and your bedroom, ideal for hybrid working, relaxed evenings in, and a more restful routine. The location is a genuine highlight. Positioned within easy reach of Manchester city living, you'll find supermarkets, schools, leisure facilities and healthcare, Uni Manchester Met close by for day-to-day ease, while excellent rail links make commuting and weekends away feel effortless. Manchester Airport is also accessible when you need it, whether for business trips or spontaneous getaways. It's the kind of place that feels good to come home to, and even better to make your own and for students/those working at the Uni's/Met it's well situated or investors. results.summary: Situated in one of the most prestigious developments in Didsbury, this stunning, modern, duplex apartment is offered to the market with no-onward chain and sure to make a splash with its copper free-standing bathtub, incredible living space and centre-piece staircase. The development itself is located just off Wilmslow Road, and is a gated access community. The property comes with a tandem parking space in the communal car park which surrounds the expansive grounds, tapering up to the beautiful building itself. It isn't often you find a personalised rope swing in the garden, but it ticks that box too if that is what you're after! The communal areas hark back to a past era, with tiled flooring and eye-catching stained glass ceiling flooding the space with natural light, and heading up the staircase you will find the apartment entrance on the first floor. Entering into the property you firstly find yourself in the modern, sleek, kitchen space, with base and eye level units filling the walls, but with an original brick fireplace really drawing the gaze. Here you will find space for a fridge/freezer, washing machine, dishwasher and fitted ovens. Completing the room you will find an understairs storage space and door leading into the main living area. This stunning living room stretches to almost 24 feet in length into the bay window, and is absolutely flooded with natural light from dual aspect windows. Another central hearth gives homage to the original aspects of the building, but this is a space that could really be utilised in any way. Previously, seating has been central with a dining area to the bay, but really, your imagination is the limit here. From the kitchen there is a winding staircase leading up to the first floor landing area, with glass balustrades and velux windows. From here you access the first of the bedrooms. Here you can really see some of the original features coming through, exposed beams and pitched windows. This bedroom also comes with an en-suite shower room with WC and sink. Over the landing is arguably my favourite room in the apartment (running the living room into a close second). The main family bathroom isn't done justice by the phrase "four piece". The Porcelanosa copper bath sits proud at the end of the room, serviced by a floor mounted copper tap and shower attachment. There is a further WC and vanity unit with over sink mirror with tap to activate light. Completing this beautiful room is the walk in shower, again an understatement, as it is bigger than most bathrooms itself! I love the wall storage here and the impressive double shower head. On from the here is a second landing space with doors leading to the third bedroom (in of itself an excellent double!) and the third, arguably main, bedroom. This bedroom has been decorated to a completely unique level, with imported cow hide effect wallpaper, fire surround and double windows. Make sure to get in touch to book your viewing as soon as possible! results.description: Melissa Berry Estates are pleased to offer this neutrally decorated two-bedroom flat on tree lined road overlooking the river roach, with lift access for sale within a private, gated development off Middleton Road in north Manchester. walking distance to metrolink Situated on the third (top) floor, the property benefits from a bright, clean interior and private off-road parking, making it suitable for first-time buyers, investors and families seeking practical accommodation with strong commuter links. Internally, the flat offers an open-plan reception room and kitchen, creating a sociable living and dining space. Large windows provide good natural light and a pleasant garden view over the development. The open-plan kitchen benefits from natural light and is arranged to maximise usable workspace while remaining integrated with the main living area. Also benefitting from a storage room off the main hallway. There are two double bedrooms. The master bedroom includes an en-suite shower room, providing added convenience and privacy. The second bedroom is also a double, offering flexible use as a guest room, children's bedroom or home office. In addition to the en-suite, there is a main bathroom fitted with a bath. Both the main bathroom and en-suite are equipped with heated towel rails. The property forms part of a private development, set back from the main road, with gated access and private off-road parking for residents. The location off Middleton Road places the flat well for commuting into Manchester city centre by road, Metrolink or bus. Middleton Road links easily to the A664 and the M60, providing connections across Greater Manchester and beyond. Public transport options are close by. The nearest Metrolink stops are within a short drive or cycle, offering frequent tram services into Manchester city centre and other key destinations such as Bury and Rochdale. Local bus routes along Middleton Road provide further access into central Manchester, with typical journey times to the city centre often around 20–30 minutes, depending on service and traffic conditions. The area benefits from a choice of green spaces, nearby parks, walking routes and cycling routes, making it suitable for those who value outdoor recreation. The local road and path network around Middleton Road offers straightforward access to these amenities, with opportunities for everyday walking, running and cycling. North Manchester General Hospital is within easy reach, making the flat well located for those working at or needing regular access to the hospital. There are also places of worship in the wider area, along with a range of local shops, services and cafés found along Middleton Road and the surrounding neighbourhoods. Larger retail and leisure options are accessible by car or public transport towards Manchester city centre and nearby district centres. The property is chain free and falls within Council Tax Band C. Overall, this two-bedroom flat offers practical accommodation on the top floor of a gated development, with private parking and convenient access to transport links, green spaces and key local amenities in north Manchester. The property is well-positioned in the desirable Whalley Range area of Manchester, with a number of highly regarded schools close by, including Manley Park Primary School and William Hulme’s Grammar School, as well as St Bede’s College, all within easy walking distance. Local amenities are readily accessible, with a variety of independent shops, cafés, and eateries nearby, along Upper Chorlton Road. Stairs leading to the first-floor landing reveal three good sized bedrooms, a two-piece bathroom and separate W.C. The property further benefits from gas fired central heating, picture railings, stained glass windows, a rear enclosed garden, and a driveway providing off road parking. Internal inspection essential to appreciate this home. Externally - At the front, the property features a prairie garden of grasses and flowering perennials, with an apple and pear tree, framed by a low brick boundary wall, with double wrought-iron gates opening onto a driveway offering off-road parking. Timber gates provide access to practical covered side storage. To the rear, a beautifully maintained lawned garden is bordered by a mix of plants, shrubs, and bushes, mature fruit trees; apple, damson plum and cherry, creating a tranquil and private setting. A fully insulated garden room with mains distribution box and secure relayed internet, providing a quiet work from home office space, is positioned at the back of the garden. results.description: The Property A beautifully presented modern two-bedroom apartment, located in the highly sought-after Steele House on Woden Street, Salford. This stylish property is ideal for first-time buyers, professionals, or investors, and benefits from the added advantage of no vendor chain, ensuring a smooth and straightforward purchase. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall that provides access to all rooms and offers useful storage space. The heart of the home is the bright and contemporary open-plan kitchen and living area, designed to maximise both space and natural light. The kitchen is fitted with modern units and integrated appliances, seamlessly flowing into a comfortable living space—perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. The apartment features a generously sized master bedroom complete with a sleek en-suite shower room, providing privacy and convenience. The second bedroom is also well-proportioned and versatile, suitable for use as a guest room, home office, or additional living space. A modern family bathroom, finished to a high standard, serves the second bedroom and guests. Further benefits include secure entry, well-maintained communal areas, and a desirable location with excellent access to Salford Quays, Manchester City Centre, local amenities, and transport links. Offered with no onward chain, this is a fantastic opportunity to acquire a modern, move-in-ready apartment in a prime location. Early viewing is highly recommended. results.summary: An attractive double bay-fronted detached residence offering spacious (2,785sq ft) and beautifully presented accommodation in the heart of West Didsbury. This impressive family home combines period charm with modern living, featuring three reception rooms, four generous double bedrooms, two contemporary bathrooms, and a superb open-plan kitchen with central island. The property sits on a large private plot with a detached garage, ample off-road parking, and an expansive landscaped garden. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with refitted WC, a bright bay-fronted living room, and a sitting room overlooking the garden. A useful utility room provides additional storage and plumbing for appliances. The highlight is the stunning open-plan kitchen/dining room, complete with integrated Bosch appliances, granite worktops, a central island, and French doors opening onto the rear garden. results.summary: 12th floor one bedroom apartment at Crown View, Victoria Riverside, due to complete December 2025. Owner occupiers & Investors welcome. Description Discover Victoria Riverside, a premium development offering a selection of stylish one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each finished to an exceptional standard. Designed with modern living in mind, the apartments feature open-plan layouts, contemporary interiors, and floor-to-ceiling picture frame windows that provide views of the anticipated City River Park, the River Irk, and the dynamic City Centre skyline. Residents will benefit from a selection of outstanding on-site amenities, such as 24hr concierge, state of the art gym, lounge and co-working areas and podium gardens as well as a variety of local independent commercial spaces right on your doorstep. Perfectly positioned just north of Manchester City Centre—nestled between the vibrant Green Quarter and the creative hub of Ancoats, this development offers residents outstanding connectivity. Residents can also enjoy easy access to the commercial district of NOMA, the eclectic Northern Quarter, and a wealth of green spaces and tranquil neighbourhoods, all while staying connected via excellent transport links in and out of the city. Contact Savills for further information and to explore the current options available. Location Jointly developed and funded by FEC and Manchester City Council, Victoria North (previously Manchester's Northern Gateway) is set to create 15,000 new homes across 155 hectares and seven neighbourhoods over the next 20 years, helping the shortfall in housing in Manchester. The redevelopment project will create better-connected public spaces, new and improved transport links, and more homes, parks and retail spaces for the city’s growing population. Victoria Riverside is at the forefront of the new, distinct residential neighbourhood at Red Bank and New Town, benefitting from its location within Manchester City Centre, but offering something new to its community. Victoria Riverside, marks the start of the creation of the City River Park. At approximately 46 ha, it will become one of Manchester's largest city centre green spaces. City River Park will enhance existing habitats and create new habitats for wildlife and be guided by climate positive design to create results which as carbon neutral as possible. Red Bank and New Town will provide the first phase of the City River Park. Over 35,000 sqm of new and improved parkland including St Catherine’s Wood and the River Irk will be delivered in this first phase with HIF investment made by 2024 in line with anticipated completion of the Victoria Riverside scheme.
