results.summary: The Property Situated within the ever-popular Newall Green, this beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home offers an ideal combination of comfort, practicality and superb connectivity, making it a perfect choice for families, first-time buyers and professionals alike. The property has recently undergone cosmetic improvements and is truly turn-key ready, featuring a contemporary fitted kitchen and a modern bathroom, allowing purchasers to move straight in with minimal effort. The area itself is highly sought after, with residents drawn to its excellent transport links including easy access to the motorway network and Metrolink services, providing convenient routes into Manchester city centre and surrounding areas. Manchester Airport is also within close proximity, ideal for frequent travellers and those working within the aviation sector, while Wythenshawe Hospital is nearby, offering both excellent healthcare facilities and employment opportunities. A range of well-regarded schools and local shopping amenities are also within easy reach, further enhancing the appeal of this location. General Information Internally, the property is well presented throughout, beginning with a bright entrance hall benefitting from two UPVC double glazed windows which flood the space with natural light, along with useful under-stairs storage housing the Worcester combi boiler. The lounge is a comfortable and inviting space opening into a separate dining room provides ample space for entertaining or family meals, while the modern fitted kitchen offers a range of base and eye-level units with complementary work surfaces, integrated oven, hob and dishwasher, space for additional appliances and access to the side via a part-glazed UPVC door. To the first floor, the landing leads to two generous double bedrooms, both benefitting from fitted wardrobes, along with a third bedroom which is ideal for use as a nursery, home office or guest room. A modern family bathroom completes the accommodation. Externally, the property enjoys a delightful enclosed rear garden with a southerly aspect, mainly laid to lawn and perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining during the warmer months. To the side, there is clear potential to extend subject to the relevant planning permissions, while the garage is equipped with light and power. To the front, a pressed concrete driveway provides ample off-road parking. Further benefits include gas central heating, UPVC double glazing throughout. This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-located and move-in-ready home in a thriving and well-connected area. results.summary: Discover Your Dream Home in South Manchester. Step into this stunning four-bedroom detached home, perfectly situated in one of Manchester’s most vibrant suburbs. Description With its blend of traditional styling and modern, open-plan living, the Cheltenham is a welcoming place to come home to. Plot 41 - The Showhome Across three storeys, its generous proportions and high ceilings create the space in which to enjoy the best of family life. The ground-floor living room and open-plan kitchen/diner invite everyone to spend time together in the ways they love best. Upon the first floor, there are three spacious bedrooms, one with high-quality en-suite facilities, while the impressive premier suite on the second floor is a luxurious retreat, featuring large fitted wardrobes and its own beautiful en-suite bathroom. Dalton Fields is a stylish development of 65 three and four-bedroom homes for couples and families looking for a sustainable and community-oriented lifestyle. The development sits in popular Chorlton, Manchester, with easy access to public transport, shops and green spaces. Chorlton is known for its thriving community spirit, diverse dining options and strong cultural scene. Check out the street view here - Whether you venture into Manchester city centre or stay closer to home, you'll be spoilt for choice when it comes to food, drink and cultural events. Meanwhile, the highly-rated local schools provide the perfect place for education. *Please note, all floor plans and dimensions for this house type are indicative only. Please speak to the Homes Advisor for relevant information.* Location Dalton Fields is a short walk away from the Chorlton tram stop, a lively throughway with tram departures every 1-4 minutes, even at off-peak times. Manchester’s thriving tram network opens up destinations across the city and its suburbs, from Moorside Ashton and Oldham to the famed Trafford Centre and even Manchester Airport. Manchester puts heavy focus on its public transport network, combining buses and trams into the Bee Network and making regular improvements such as purchasing additional buses and introducing new bus services. Dalton Fields is served by the bus stop at Wyeverne Road next to the development, where you can catch buses to the Trafford Centre and Piccadilly Gardens in the city centre. Families looking for new build houses in Manchester will be pleased to know that Chorlton has plenty of highly rated nurseries and schools, as well as proximity to the highly competitive University of Manchester. The closest nursery offering full day care is the Simply Cherish Day Nursery, a short walk away from home. Commuting parents can also drop their children off at the Kenwood Day Nursery or the Little Learners Day Nursery, both of which are a short walk away. Dalton Fields benefits from six highly rated primary schools within walking distance, giving you plenty of choice to match your specifications. The closest on foot is the Manley Park Primary School. Secondary students can attend the Whalley Range 11-18 High School, a sixth form a short walk away from home, allowing pupils to make their own way to school. The Chorlton High School is slightly closer, giving you two options for local teenagers. Chorlton is home to several grammar schools close to the development, including the William Hulme’s Grammar School for children between 3 and 18, where pupils can participate in the Duke of Edinburgh award alongside plenty of extracurricular activities. The Stretford Grammar School is also nearby, accepting secondary students between 11 and 18 years old. results.summary: Ideal For First-Time Buyers, Downsizers Or Investors Seeking A Straightforward Move…Situated on Daisy Bank Avenue in Swinton, this extended freehold property is offered with no chain and occupies a prominent corner position with a generous plot. The exterior provides off-street parking to the front, with gated access leading to a well-proportioned rear garden. The garden is south-east facing, enjoying good natural light, and features a combination of paved patio and lawn, along with fenced boundaries and a detached storage shed. Internally, the property is well presented throughout with a neutral décor scheme, creating a bright and consistent finish across all rooms. The entrance hall leads into a comfortable living room positioned to the front, with ample space for seating. To the rear, a separate dining room provides a defined area for family meals and entertaining. The extended kitchen offers a practical layout with a range of fitted units, worktop space and integrated cooking appliances, along with space for additional white goods. A door provides direct access to the rear garden. To the first floor, there are two double bedrooms, both benefiting from fitted storage, and a modern bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite including bath with shower over, wash basin and WC. The property is well positioned for access to the A580 East Lancashire Road, providing direct routes into Manchester and surrounding areas. Swinton town centre is within easy reach, offering a range of shops, amenities and transport links, while local schools including St John's CofE Primary School are a stone's throw. Overall, a well-maintained, extended home in a convenient and established residential location, offered with no onward chain. Additional Information The property is a freehold home located within Salford Local Authority, falling into council tax band B with an annual charge of £1,907. It has an EPC rating of C and offers a total floor area of approximately 70.9m² (763.16ft²). The property is heated via a gas combi boiler, last serviced in 2025. results.summary: A beautiful family home with three fantastic sized bedrooms and a stylish interior with driveway parking and a generous garden. EPC - C. Ready to move into and impeccably presented from top to bottom, this beautiful modern three bedroom detached is the perfect turnkey home for family buyers and upsizers. Situated on Winnie Street around 5 miles outside of Manchester, the property enjoys a convenient location well serviced by commuter links, plenty of local shops, close proximity to outdoor walks and local Primary and Secondary Schools. results.summary: An elegant three-bedroom semi-detached period home, discreetly positioned on the quiet cul-de-sac of Chapel Street in the heart of Heaton Mersey. Extending to 85 SQMK arranged across two floors, this well-presented property combines period charm with modern finishes, making it an ideal purchase for discerning first-time buyers and young families. Properties of this calibre and location are rarely available for long, and early viewing is strongly advised and viewings will commence 30th MARCH 2026. Video tour available Chapel Street enjoys an enviable position within one of the area’s most desirable residential pockets, sitting almost equidistant between Heaton Moor and Didsbury villages. Both offer a vibrant mix of independent retailers, cafés, bars, and everyday amenities. East Didsbury Metrolink is within a short five-minute walk, while the mainline rail station can be reached in under ten minutes, providing excellent commuter links. Highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby further enhance the home’s appeal. The accommodation opens via a porch into a welcoming entrance hallway with useful understairs storage and a convenient ground floor WC. The ground floor offers a well-proportioned front living room, complemented by a larger rear dining room ideal for entertaining, and a newly installed contemporary kitchen positioned to the rear. To the first floor are two generous double bedrooms and a further single bedroom, alongside a stylish, newly fitted shower room finished with modern tiling, a three-piece suite, and heated towel rail. Externally, the property benefits from a pleasant rear garden. The rear garden is laid out with a combination of paved areas, lawn, and a secluded seating space to the far end, enjoying excellent sunlight throughout the day. results.summary: A beautifully presented and significantly extended four-bedroom, two-bathroom semi-detached 1930's property, ideally located on a highly sought-after residential cul-de-sac close to Fog Lane Park, Didsbury Village, and a range of excellent local amenities. This superb family home has been thoughtfully extended and improved by the current owners and offers spacious, versatile accommodation. As part of this impressive renovation, the owners have respected the age and heritage of the house, ensuring the home is full of 1930’s character and tradition, yet contemporary where it matters. Set over three floors, the property offers an entrance porch with double doors opening to the front, leading into a welcoming entrance hallway with stairs rising to the first floor and access to a downstairs WC. At the front of the property is a charming lounge featuring a 'Clearview' wood-burning stove set within a fireplace and a beautiful bay window overlooking the front garden. The true highlight of the home is the impressive open-plan living/kitchen/diner to the rear, creating a fantastic space for both everyday living and entertaining. Large sliding patio doors open onto the rear garden, while a central skylight lantern floods the space with natural light. The kitchen is fitted with a range of base units with worktops over and matching wall units, complemented by a substantial central island with breakfast bar seating and an attractive exposed brick chimney breast. Leading off the kitchen is a further extension providing a useful utility/boot room with a door opening to the side of the property. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a beautifully appointed family bathroom fitted with a four-piece 'Burlington' white suite incorporating a freestanding roll-top bath. A loft conversion creates a superb principal bedroom with dressing area and a stylish en-suite shower room. Externally, the property benefits from a driveway to the front with EV charging point and wrought iron gates, along with a garden area with mature shrubs. The rear garden is generously sized, featuring a central lawn, 'York Stone' patio seating area and space for a large timber shed. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate this wonderful home. Call now to arrange an appointment. results.summary: Step inside this welcoming home and you are immediately greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere. The ground floor offers a well-balanced layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The lounge provides a comfortable space to relax, filled with natural light, while the separate dining room creates the perfect setting for family meals or hosting guests. Flowing seamlessly from here, the conservatory offers an additional versatile living area-ideal as a sitting room, playroom, or a peaceful spot to enjoy the garden throughout the seasons. The modern fitted kitchen has been thoughtfully designed, offering both style and practicality, with ample storage and workspace for keen home cooks. Completing the ground floor is a conveniently located bathroom, adding flexibility for busy households. First Floor Accommodation Taking the stairs to the first floor, the property continues to impress with well-proportioned and tastefully presented rooms. You will find two generous double bedrooms, each offering comfortable and spacious living space, alongside a third bedroom which is also of a very good size-perfect as a child's room, guest room, or home office. The first floor is served by a modern fitted shower room, finished to a high standard, providing a sleek and contemporary space to start your day. Outdoor Space & Location Occupying a desirable corner plot, this property truly stands out with its impressive outdoor offering. The garden has been lovingly maintained and is well-stocked with a variety of fruit trees, including figs, grapes, and apples-creating a unique and productive outdoor space. A charming herb garden further enhances the appeal for those who enjoy growing their own produce. Practicality is also key, with off-road parking and a carport providing space for two to three vehicles. The location is highly convenient, offering excellent access to Manchester International Airport, South Manchester University Hospital, and a wide range of local amenities. Commuters will appreciate the easy connections to the M56 and M60 motorway networks, making travel across the region straightforward. Castlefield has two Metrolink stops, Cornbrook and Deansgate, which connect both to city centre and offer easy access to Salford Quays and southern areas such as Altrincham, Chorlton, Didsbury and Manchester Airport. The city centre itself can also be reached easily on foot in under ten minutes, and there are various supermarkets within a five-minute walk of St George's Island. Jordan Fishwick are pleased to offer for sale this impressive new 13th floor apartment offering great views, covered balcony and high specification fixtures and fittings throughout. The apartment is approximately 931 sq ft in total. Comprising of entrance hallway with dark wood flooring leading to open plan living area, gloss kitchen with integrated appliances including dishwasher. Large storage closet housing washer drier. Three double bedrooms, all with fitted mirrored wardrobes, the master benefitting from a stunning en-suite with rain effect shower. Large hotel style main bathroom. There is a balcony accessed via on of the three bedrooms. There are also two parking spaces included within the sale price. EWS-1 B1 Rating. The Building - The development includes access to a residents-only ground floor terrace with covered seating area, landscaped 12th floor roof garden with amazing views, spacious interior designed lobby and concierge facilities. Secure bike storage also on site. The Hallmark is an architectural landmark for the area. A prominent building, with a sophisticated bronze coloured facade. The stylish and contemporary interiors feature high specification finishes that have been carefully selected to complement the eye-catching architecture. With excellent transport connections, The Hallmark stands proudly on the doorstep of one of Manchester s most vibrant districts. Entrance Hall - Wooden flooring. Spotlights. Wall mounted electric heater. Access to all rooms. Storage cupboard housing boiler. Living Room/Kitchen - 6.26 x 4.81 (20'6" x 15'9") - Range of wall and base units with complimentary work tops over. Integrated fridge/freezer and dishwasher. Sink with mixer tap. Under counter lighting. Wooden flooring. Spotlights. Wall mounted electric heater. TV and telephone point. Bedroom One - 4.59 x 2.75 (15'0" x 9'0") - Fitted carpet. Spotlights. Fitted wardrobes. Wall mounted electric heater. En-Suite - 2.62 x 1.56 (8'7" x 5'1") - Partially tiled. Shower cubical with mixer shower over. Low lever W/C. Pedestal sink with mixer tap. Heated towel rail. Bedroom Two - 4.06 x 2.94 (13'3" x 9'7") - Fitted carpet. Spotlights. Fitted wardrobes. Wall mounted electric heater. Bedroom Three - 4.06 x 2.94 (13'3" x 9'7") - Fitted carpet. Spotlights. Fitted wardrobes. Wall mounted electric heater. Access to enclosed balcony. Bathroom - 2.26 x 1.96 (7'4" x 6'5") - Three piece bathroom. Partially tiled. Bath with mixer shower over. Low lever W/C. Pedestal sink with mixer tap. Heated towel rail. Externally - Private balcony. Roof top terrace. 24 hour concierge. Bike storage. Lifts to all floors. 2 Parking spaces Additional Information - Lease - 150 Years from 01st August 2006 £300 increases after 22 years in line with RPI and then every 10 years thereafter. Service charges - £5,916.68 (including buildings insurance) Ground rent - £300 per annum Council Tax Band E EPC Rating - B Agents

results.summary: Nestled in the heart of Manchester, this charming two-bedroom apartment offers a perfect blend of contemporary living and urban convenience, priced attractively at £270,000. Ideal for first-time buyers, professionals, or investors, this property boasts a well-thought-out layout that maximises space and natural light throughout. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway that provides a warm introduction to the home and ample storage options for coats and shoes. The hallway leads seamlessly into the bright and airy reception room, a versatile space perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. Large windows flood the room with natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere, while the neutral décor offers a blank canvas for your personal style. The kitchen, integrated within the reception area, is fitted with modern units and appliances, designed to meet all your culinary needs. Whether you`re preparing a quick breakfast or hosting a dinner party, this space is both practical and stylish. The apartment features two well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering generous storage and comfort. The master bedroom benefits from an en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and convenience. Both bathrooms are finished to a high standard, featuring contemporary fixtures and fittings, with the main bathroom easily accessible from the hallway. Additional benefits include double glazing throughout, central heating, and secure entry systems, ensuring comfort and peace of mind. The property is situated within a well-maintained building, with communal areas that reflect the quality of the development. Location is key, and this apartment does not disappoint. Situated in Manchester, you are just moments away from a wealth of amenities, transport links, and cultural attractions. Whether you commute for work or enjoy the vibrant city lifestyle, this property offers the perfect base. Manchester is a city brimming with history, culture, and entertainment. For those who appreciate the arts, the Manchester Art Gallery and the Whitworth offer impressive collections and exhibitions. Music lovers will find a thriving scene, with venues such as the O2 Apollo and the Albert Hall hosting a variety of live performances throughout the year. Shopping enthusiasts can explore the bustling Arndale Centre or the independent boutiques of the Northern Quarter, known for its creative vibe and street art. Foodies will delight in the diverse culinary scene, from traditional British pubs to international cuisine, with many restaurants and cafes dotted around the city centre and beyond. For outdoor leisure, the nearby Castlefield Urban Heritage Park provides a peaceful retreat with canals, green spaces, and historic landmarks. Sports fans can enjoy matches at Old Trafford or the Etihad Stadium, home to Manchester United and Manchester City respectively. Manchester also boasts excellent transport connections, including direct trains to London and other major cities, as well as an extensive tram network that makes getting around the city straightforward. In summary, this two-bedroom apartment offers a fantastic opportunity to own a stylish and comfortable home in one of the UK`s most dynamic cities. With its excellent location, modern features, and proximity to everything Manchester has to offer, it represents outstanding value for money. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this property has to offer. Notice Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only. results.summary: This attractive ground floor apartment is set within Bridgewater House at the sought-after Slate Wharf development in the heart of Castlefield. Offering a well-proportioned layout, the property comprises one spacious bedroom and a modern bathroom, making it ideal for professionals, first-time buyers, or investors alike. A standout feature of the apartment is the generous private outdoor terrace, providing a perfect space for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying some fresh air—an uncommon benefit in such a central location. The property also includes the added convenience of allocated parking. Slate Wharf is perfectly positioned within Castlefield, one of Manchester’s most desirable and historic districts, known for its canals, converted warehouses, and vibrant atmosphere. Residents benefit from excellent transport connections, with nearby tram and train links offering easy access across the city and beyond. Deansgate, with its wide range of shops, restaurants, bars, and amenities, is just a short walk away, making this an exceptionally convenient and appealing place to live. The Tour - Step inside this well-presented ground floor apartment and you are welcomed into a spacious entrance hallway, setting the tone for the rest of the home and providing access to all areas of the accommodation. From the hallway, you’ll find two useful storage cupboards. One houses a Hotpoint washing machine and an Indesit dryer, offering practical utility space, while the second contains the water heater and provides additional room for general storage. The hallway then opens into a bright and generously sized living area, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. This inviting space benefits from direct access onto a large private terrace, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living—an excellent spot for enjoying warmer days or hosting guests. Leading off the living area is the separate kitchen, which is well-equipped with a range of integrated appliances, including a Bosch fridge freezer, Hotpoint hob, Indesit microwave, and Hotpoint oven, offering everything needed for modern day-to-day living. The spacious bedroom is enhanced by large windows that allow plenty of natural light to flood the room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. Completing the property is the bathroom, fitted with a bath and overhead shower, toilet, and sink. A particularly appealing feature is the presence of a window, providing natural light and ventilation—something not always found in apartment bathrooms. The Area - Slate Wharf is ideally located within Castlefield, one of Manchester’s most sought-after and characterful districts. Known for its historic canals, converted warehouses, and scenic towpaths, the area offers a peaceful, waterside setting while remaining on the edge of the city centre. Castlefield has a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, with a selection of independent bars, restaurants, and cafés, many overlooking the canal. The area also benefits from nearby cultural attractions and open spaces, adding to its appeal. In terms of connectivity, the location is highly convenient, with Deansgate station and Metrolink tram links just a short walk away, providing easy access across Manchester and beyond. Overall, Slate Wharf offers an excellent balance of tranquillity, character, and city living. results.summary: Bridgfords are delighted to present this truly immaculate three-bedroom semi-detached property on the ever-popular Palm Street, Droylsden. This exceptional home stands out for its complete internal rebuild and flawless presentation, offering genuine move-in ready condition and contemporary design throughout. Every detail has been carefully considered, giving any future owner complete peace of mind. To the front, a walled garden provides privacy and an attractive setting, setting the property back from the street. Stepping inside, you are greeted by a welcoming entrance hallway that immediately sets the tone for the rest of the home — bright, stylish, and thoughtfully designed. At the heart of the property lies the open-plan ground floor, an inviting space ideal for modern family life. The spacious lounge features a cosy feel with a charming feature fireplace, a large front window flooding the room with natural light, and tasteful décor throughout. Flowing seamlessly from the living area is the kitchen and dining space, which blends traditional touches with contemporary flair. The kitchen is beautifully appointed with built-in appliances, ample worktop space, and a stunning central island with breakfast bar. Hardwood herringbone flooring and skylights enhance the space, reflecting natural light and creating a sense of warmth and openness. To the side, there’s generous room for a dining area or additional seating, making this the perfect space for entertaining or family gatherings. Upstairs, you’ll find three well-proportioned bedrooms, each featuring clever built-in storage with sliding doors. The master bedroom comfortably accommodates a large bed and additional furnishings, and benefits from its own en suite bathroom. The second bedroom is another double with fitted storage, while the third bedroom serves perfectly as a single room, home office, playroom, or walk-in wardrobe. The family bathroom, located on the ground floor, offers a touch of luxury with a freestanding bath, contemporary toilet and sink, and premium finishes. Externally, the quality continues with a low-maintenance resin rear garden featuring a decked seating area, garden shed, and a versatile outbuilding currently set up as a home office or additional living space — ideal for remote working, hobbies, or relaxation. Completing the outdoor space is a modern electric car charging point. This property is ideally located within easy reach of several primary and secondary schools, including Droylsden Academy right on your doorstep. You’ll also enjoy a choice of scenic nature walks nearby, with Clayton Vale, Daisy Nook Country Park, and several smaller local parks all close by. The area offers a great range of local amenities, including supermarkets, dentists, doctors, and gyms, ensuring everyday convenience. Excellent transport links are just a short walk away, with tram and bus stops providing quick access to the city centre, as well as easy connections to the M60 motorway, Co-op Live Arena, and the Etihad Stadium. This property truly is a one-of-a-kind home, redone internally and designed with style, practicality, and comfort in mind. Early viewing is essential to fully appreciate the attention to detail and quality on offer. Call Bridgfords today on to arrange your viewing and secure your dream home on Palm Street. results.summary: Sometimes you walk into a house and you instantly feel at home, and Stephens Road definitely falls into that category. It feels lived in, yet immaculately presented, modern, but without losing any of the character, and it certainly has scope to make it even more your own space. Located right on the Didsbury and Withington border the house benefits from the best of both worlds. Mauldeth Road train station is just a short walk, and you will find your fill of bars, cafes and restaurants are within easy reach. From a family point of view there are a number of Good and Outstanding schools locally, with both Universities and Hospital close by, as well as access onto the M60. Situated on a residents parking only road in Withington, this Detached property is accessed via porch, and then into the main entrance hallway. The first thing you will notice is the real wood flooring throughout, and bright, airy space that welcomes you into the home. Under the stairs there is a handy utility area, alongside a further storage cupboard. To the front of the house you have the bay windowed main living room, which is flooded with light, and is a great space for you to configure to your tastes and needs. On to the rear of the house you have the outrigger style kitchen, which is lovely in of itself, but is finished by a thoughtful seated barstool spot overlooking the rear garden. Perfect for that first coffee of the morning (or that evening glass of wine, depending on how your day has been!). Completing the main downstairs rooms you have the dining space, with French doors onto the really well-proportioned rear garden space, recently re-laid by the current owners and is a great entertaining space or garden for the kids. The fencing has been completely refreshed recently and has created a completely private garden area. Outside you have water, power, shed space and side access, which is ideal for cleaning the car or getting those awkward deliveries into the house. Heading on upstairs we have the office/third bedroom first. It is definitely one of the better sized third bedrooms I have seen, with the current owners being able to work from home and have ample space around them at the same time. The two double bedrooms flank the front and rear of the house, both good sized doubles, but the main especially has excellent floor area, with room for a bed and multiple storage units as well. Completing the upstairs is the main bathroom, with bath, shower over, WC and separate sink, modern and stylish. Accessed via drop down ladder, the loft has been fully boarded to provide further storage options, handy for those suitcases and Christmas decorations! This really beautiful home is sure to get plenty of interest, so make sure to reach out quickly for your viewing spot on the 28th of March. results.summary: A simply stunning and immaculately presented three/four-bedroom end-terrace property, positioned on a highly sought-after and peaceful cul-de-sac in West Didsbury, complete with private parking to the side. The property has been significantly enhanced by the current owners and now offers beautifully appointed, versatile accommodation throughout. In brief, it comprises: The home is entered via an attractive stained and leaded glass front door into a welcoming hallway, with stairs leading to both the first floor and the lower ground floor. To the front, there is a generously sized lounge featuring bespoke fitted cupboards and shelving, a charming feature fireplace, and a bay window with plantation shutters and stained glass detailing. To the rear, a superb open-plan kitchen/dining room provides an ideal space for modern living and entertaining. The dining area boasts a further feature fireplace with fitted shelving and storage, while an open archway leads into the stylish kitchen, fitted with a range of low-level units with worktops over and matching wall units. Integrated appliances, a feature Belfast sink with mixer tap, and a window overlooking the rear garden complete the space. French doors open directly onto the garden, allowing for seamless indoor-outdoor living. The lower ground floor has been converted to create a highly versatile space, currently used as a sitting/music room. With a window to the front and additional storage cupboards, this room could easily serve as a fourth bedroom, particularly as it benefits from a beautifully appointed en-suite shower room. Also on this level is a useful utility room with built-in storage. To the first floor, a bright landing leads to all rooms. The principal bedroom is positioned to the front and features plantation shutters and fitted wardrobes. The second bedroom is another generous double, also with fitted wardrobes and plantation shutters. The third bedroom, currently used as a home office, would equally make an excellent bedroom and again enjoys plantation shutters to the front-facing window. The family bathroom is fitted with a contemporary three-piece white suite comprising a low-level WC, wash hand basin, and panelled bath with shower over, all finished to a high standard. Loft accessed via a pull-down ladder from the landing, offering excellent storage space and benefiting from an installed air circulation system. Externally, the property benefits from a private parking space to the side, complete with an EV charging point. To the front, a low-level brick wall encloses a charming cottage-style garden and covered porch area. The rear garden enjoys a sunny aspect and features a fully tiled floor, enclosed by brick walls with a timber gate providing access. Viewing is highly recommended, contact us today to arrange your appointment. Welcome to this three-bedroom, mid-terrace home situated on Old Road in Failsworth, with generous living space, a neutral finish throughout and excellent access to local amenities and transport links it is ideal for first-time buyers or investors alike. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed into a useful entrance vestibule, providing separation from the main living space. This leads through to a spacious living room, finished in fresh white décor with dark grey carpeting, creating a bright, modern feel. A door from the living room opens into the large kitchen/diner, a versatile space with ample room for a full dining table or even a second reception area. The kitchen is fitted with dark grey units, light grey worktops and a white tiled floor, offering a clean, contemporary look. There’s an electric cooker and sink fitted, plenty of cabinet storage and counter space and room for additional appliances. A rear door provides direct access to the private yard. To the first floor, the property boasts three well-proportioned bedrooms. To the front is a large double bedroom, while to the rear are two generous single rooms, ideal for children’s bedrooms, home office space or guest accommodation. The family bathroom is fitted with a bath with shower over, WC and wash basin, it is finished with a tiled floor and tiled walls around the bath area. The home has been painted white throughout, with dark grey carpeting, offering a true blank canvas for the next owner to personalise and make their own. Externally, the property benefits from a rear yard with access to the back alley, while the front is pavement-fronted, in keeping with the surrounding terrace. Situated in a convenient and popular area of Failsworth, the property is close to a range of local shops and supermarkets, schools and amenities, all within easy reach. Excellent transport links are nearby, including bus routes and Metrolink services situated just across the road from the property, providing straightforward access into Manchester city centre and surrounding areas. Road links are also close by, with easy access to the M60 making commuting around the Manchester area easy. This property is ideal for someone who is looking for something to put their own stamp on. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the space and potential on offer. Call us now to arrange your viewing! results.summary: Normie Estate Agents are pleased to present this three-bedroom semi-detached home located in the popular residential area of Crumpsall, Manchester. The property offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout and would make an ideal purchase for families, first-time buyers or anyone seeking a home within convenient reach of Manchester city centre. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway which provides a practical area for coats, shoes and everyday storage. A staircase leads to the first floor, while the hallway provides access to the principal ground floor rooms. The ground floor accommodation comprises a front living room, rear dining room and a dining kitchen. The main reception room enjoys a large window to the front elevation, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the space and creating a comfortable setting for everyday living. To the rear, doors open out onto the garden, creating a natural connection between the indoor living space and the outdoor area, particularly enjoyable during the warmer months. The extended ground floor footprint gives the property a greater sense of space and flexibility. Upstairs, the property offers three well-proportioned bedrooms. The main bedroom provides a generous double room with space for wardrobes and additional furniture. The second bedroom is also a good-sized double and benefits from built-in wardrobes. The third bedroom is a single room, ideal for use as a children’s bedroom, guest room or home office depending on individual requirements. The accommodation is served by a family bathroom along with a separate WC. Externally, the property benefits from driveway parking. To the rear, the garden features a small patio area leading onto a lawned section, offering a pleasant outdoor space suitable for seating, entertaining or family use. Crumpsall is a popular residential area in North Manchester with good access to everyday amenities, schools and transport links. Local green spaces include Crumpsall Park, while the much larger Heaton Park is also within easy reach for walking, leisure activities and open space. The area offers a range of nearby shops, supermarkets, cafés and takeaways, with further retail and dining options available in Cheetham Hill and Prestwich. Manchester city centre is also easily accessible. Transport connections are strong, with Crumpsall Metrolink station providing direct tram routes into the city centre in around 15–20 minutes, along with regular bus services nearby. For those travelling by car, the M60 and M62 motorway networks are both within convenient reach. results.summary: This extended four-bedroom semi-detached home is a true hidden gem, tucked away in a desirable cul-de-sac and occupying an impressive corner plot. Offering both space and versatility, the property is ideal for modern family living. It is approached via a block-paved driveway providing ample off-road parking, electric car charging point, with double doors opening into a useful storage area. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a bright entrance hall complete with understairs storage. To the right, a generously sized living room features stylish wood flooring and a charming feature fire surround, creating a warm and inviting space. French doors lead seamlessly into the dining room, while a front-facing window offers pleasant views up the road. The dining room is a standout space, enhanced by feature skylights that flood the room with natural light. With wood flooring throughout and two sets of patio doors opening onto the garden, it provides the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The breakfast kitchen is well-appointed with a range of base and eye-level units complemented by wood work surfaces. It benefits from tiled flooring, a breakfast bar, a range of integrated appliances, and additional space for freestanding appliances. Leading from the kitchen is a practical utility room, which offers further appliance space, houses the boiler (fitted in 2025), and features French doors to the rear along with internal access to the storage area. A convenient downstairs WC completes the ground floor. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with four well-proportioned bedrooms, including three doubles and a spacious single. The family bathroom is fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a bath with shower over, WC, and wash hand basin. The lofts are also boarded for additional storage. The main bedroom is particularly noteworthy, boasting windows to both the front and rear aspects, fitted wardrobes, and a stylish en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, WC, and wash hand basin. Externally, the home sits on a fabulous-sized plot, offering a wonderful outdoor space for all to enjoy. The garden features a large stone patio area, ideal for entertaining, and is predominantly laid to lawn with timber fence boundaries ensuring privacy. Additional highlights include a brick-built BBQ and a fantastic home office with sliding patio doors, perfect for remote working or a variety of uses. Situated in the ever-popular area of Northenden, close to the vibrant village of Didsbury. The nearby River Mersey and its scenic walking and cycling routes provide beautiful outdoor spaces right on your doorstep, perfect for leisure and relaxation. Excellent local amenities, reputable schools, and strong transport links into Manchester city centre and beyond further enhance the appeal of this sought-after location. It is approached via a block-paved driveway providing ample off-road parking, electric car charging point, with double doors opening into a useful storage area. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a bright entrance hall complete with understairs storage. To the right, a generously sized living room features stylish wood flooring and a charming feature fire surround, creating a warm and inviting space. French doors lead seamlessly into the dining room, while a front-facing window offers pleasant views up the road. The dining room is a standout space, enhanced by feature skylights that flood the room with natural light. With wood flooring throughout and two sets of patio doors opening onto the garden, it provides the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The breakfast kitchen is well-appointed with a range of base and eye-level units complemented by wood work surfaces. It benefits from tiled flooring, a breakfast bar, a range of integrated appliances, and additional space for freestanding appliances. Leading from the kitchen is a practical utility room, which offers further appliance space, houses the boiler (fitted in 2025), and features French doors to the rear along with internal access to the storage area. A convenient downstairs WC completes the ground floor. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with four well-proportioned bedrooms, including three doubles and a spacious single. The family bathroom is fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a bath with shower over, WC, and wash hand basin. The lofts are also boarded for additional storage. The main bedroom is particularly noteworthy, boasting windows to both the front and rear aspects, fitted wardrobes, and a stylish en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, WC, and wash hand basin. Externally, the home sits on a fabulous-sized plot, offering a wonderful outdoor space for all to enjoy. The garden features a large stone patio area, ideal for entertaining, and is predominantly laid to lawn with timber fence boundaries ensuring privacy. Additional highlights include a brick-built BBQ and a fantastic home office with sliding patio doors, perfect for remote working or a variety of uses. Situated in the ever-popular area of Northenden, close to the vibrant village of Didsbury. The nearby River Mersey and its scenic walking and cycling routes provide beautiful outdoor spaces right on your doorstep, perfect for leisure and relaxation. Excellent local amenities, reputable schools, and strong transport links into Manchester city centre and beyond further enhance the appeal of this sought-after location. results.summary: Bankside is a contemporary development with brick podium detailing, which proudly sits within Colliers Yard, a new and vibrant neighbourhood located in Greengate. At Bankside, Colliers Yard, there will be three resident lounges and two bookable multi-use suites for residents to relax and enjoy. Creative space has been designed to support residents' creativity and features a relaxed breakout area, with adjoining content creation room and Instagram pods, as well as games room with pool table and Mahjong. The Club features a gymnasium, yoga & fitness studio, outdoor terrace and a locker room. The Gymnasium also opens up onto The Yard, an outdoor terrace, part of which is designated for outdoor exercise, including yoga practice. The yoga & fitness studio provides the perfect environment for residents to work out in a group scenario. The apartment itself is beautifully designed, featuring an open-plan layout with herringbone wood laminate flooring in kitchen and living areas, and fitted carpets in bedrooms. The kitchen is both stylish and functional, equipped with black splash back metro tiles, bespoke LED under-unit lighting, integrated Bosch appliances, and a wine cooler. In the fully-tiled bathroom, navy metro tiles and black Hansgrohe ironmongery, including a rain head shower, offer a contemporary touch. Each bathroom includes a generously sized steel bath, wall-mounted wash basin and WC with concealed cistern and soft-close seat, along with bespoke storage featuring mirrored doors and shelving, creating a welcoming and well-designed space. results.summary: Goodwin Fish is delighted to offer an opportunity to acquire a canal facing apartment in one of Manchester`s most iconic developments, Timber Wharf. Famous for lacquer finished unpainted concrete walls and floor to ceiling windows, Timber Wharf offers a point of difference and maintains a well respected reputation in a vastly eclectic property market. Located in historic Castlefield, the area is within walking distance to Deansgate Square, restaurants and gastro pubs including The Wharf, Dukes 92 and Alberts, the Y Club gym at Castlefield Bowl, an independent cinema, theatre and art gallery at HOME, and supermarkets such as Co-op and Tesco. The property is also ideal for access to Cornbrook Metrolink or Deansgate train station. The development benefits from Fibre, Apudos smart parcel lockers, a well maintained canal side communal garden with picnic benches and table tennis table, and an opportunity to grow your own vegetables. Located on the 3rd floor the property briefly comprises: entrance/hallway with storage; open plan lounge/diner with sliding doors onto a canal facing balcony; modern kitchen with integrated Hotpoint oven and induction hob, primary double bedroom with access to en suite facilities; second double bedroom/work from home space; primary bathroom; additional balcony accessed by both bedrooms. The property is being sold with a secure underground car parking space and is offered with vacant possession. We can confirm the development has an EWS1 form with A2 rating which may be required by lenders issuing a mortgage. results.summary: Presenting this bay fronted, deceptively spacious terraced home, offering a superb blend of period charm and contemporary living, ideally positioned for easy access into Manchester City Centre. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a generous entrance hall that sets the tone for the accommodation within. The ground floor features a large lounge and a separate dining room, both thoughtfully proportioned to provide versatile spaces for relaxing and entertaining. The lounge benefits from abundant natural light through the striking bay window, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere, while the dining room offers ample space for family meals and gatherings. The fitted kitchen is well appointed with a range of units and work surfaces, providing practical storage and preparation areas. There is also a cellar which presents excellent scope for conversion (subject to the necessary consents), offering the potential to for additional living space tailored to your needs. The four piece bathroom suite is stylishly finished and features a bath, separate shower enclosure, wash basin, and WC, designed to offer both comfort and convenience for busy households. For those seeking further space, the property offers significant potential to extend into the eaves (subject to planning permission). The layout is thoughtfully arranged to maximise both living and sleeping accommodation, ensuring the home works perfectly for modern lifestyles. Situated in a sought after residential area, this home benefits from its proximity to excellent local amenities, reputable schools, and convenient transport links, making commuting into Manchester City Centre straightforward and efficient. Whether you are a growing family, professional couple, or investor seeking a property with excellent potential, this substantial terraced home offers an outstanding opportunity to acquire a spacious and adaptable residence in a prime location. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the scale, versatility, and quality of accommodation on offer. results.summary: Hyde Estates are delighted to offer this extended, detached family home with four bedrooms for sale. This Freehold property offers spacious, well-appointed living accommodation throughout and features a fabulous open plan kitchen/family room with bifolding doors opening to a private, secluded rear garden with space for all the family to enjoy! Benefits off street parking for at least three vehicles and a detached garage which can be utilised to suit. An early viewing is highly recommended. Situated at the bottom of Vine Street, Tuscany View is a quiet cul de sac in a sought after position conveniently located on the doorstep of Kersal Moor and Kersal Wetlands, perfect for leisurely walks and enjoying nature. The property also has excellent links to both Prestwich and Manchester City Centre and their abundance of amenities via Bury New Road (A56). Accommodation - Briefly comprising; entrance hall fitted with Karndean flooring, stairs to the first floor and understairs storage cupboard, guest wc with tiled walls and frosted window. The first of three reception rooms is a spacious dual aspect lounge with feature fireplace, iSense carpet and sliding glazed doors to the extended family room. Accessed from the entrance hall via a further set of glazed sliding doors is a cosy TV/playroom with stainglass porthole window. The modern island kitchen features a breakfast bar and is fitted with a range of grey gloss wall & base units with quartz worktops and tiled splashbacks. Inset 1.5 sink unit with mixer tap and insinkerator with integral appliances including two eye-level ovens, six ring gas hob, extractor hood and integrated dishwasher with space for a freestanding 'American Style' fridge freezer, dryer and plumbing for a washing machine. Includes seperate utility space with inset sink unit and mixer tap. Fully opening to the extended family room which has space for both lounge and dining furniture, three velux windows with motorised open/shut function and bifolding doors opening to the rear garden. From the first floor landing are four fitted bedrooms with the main, front facing double room including an iSense carpet and walk in wardrobe opening to a contemporary, fully tiled ensuite shower room fitted with a modern suite of; wc, washbasin with storage drawers and walk in mains operated double shower with rainfall shower head. Complete with frosted, stainglass porthole window, heated chrome towel rail, extractor fan and fitted mirror. Both the second and third bedrooms benefit from fitted furniture and can comfortably accommodate a double bed whilst the fourth bedroom features a built in desk, wardrobe and space for a single bed. The family bathroom is fitted with a combined wc and washbasin unit and bath with overhead mains operated shower and includes; tiled walls, frosted window, extractor fan and built in cupboard. Room Measurements - Guest W.C. Lounge: 20’10" x 11’9" TV/Playoom: 10’1" x 8’3" Family Room: 25’1" x 11’7” Kitchen: 16’2" x 11’7” Bedroom 1: 11’7" x 11’3” plus walk in wardrobe. Ensuite: 9'2" x 5'5" Bedroom 2: 11’9’’ x 9’3” plus door recess Bedroom 3: 11’1" x 10’1" at extremes. Bedroom 4: 8’9” x 8’7" Bathroom: 6’11” x 5’6” Garage - Detached garage with pitched roof and electrical power. Ideal for storage with side access door from the garden. Gardens - The private rear garden is generously proportioned and features a large paved patio, accessed via bifolding doors from the kitchen/family room extension, ideal for entertaining and outside dining in the summer months. Steps lead to a raised lawn which includes a timber play jungle, mature trees and shrubbery borders. Gated to both sides with access to the garage and electric power points servicing the patio area. Parking - To the side of the property there is a driveway with space for two cars, which has an Electric Vehicle charging point and leads to the detached garage. A further space for off street parking is located to the front of the house. Additional Information - The property is fully alarmed, serviced by a wall mounted combi boiler and is predominantly fitted with uPVC double glazed windows. Tenure - We understand from the vendor that the property is FREEHOLD. Council Tax - Salford City Council, Band E. Fixtures & Fittings - Carpets, curtains, and light fittings available by negotiation. We have not tested any appliances or electrical items. Viewings - Viewings are highly recommended and can be arranged via Hyde Estate and Letting Agents Disclaimer - The information and images provided in this property advertisement are intended for guidance purposes only. While we make every effort to ensure the accuracy of the details, we strongly recommend that interested parties view the property in person to confirm the property’s condition and suitability for their specific requirements. Stamp Duty Land Tax - Residential property rates You usually pay Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) on increasing portions of the property price when you buy residential property, for example a house or flat. The amount you pay depends on: • when you bought the property • how much you paid for it • whether you’re eligible for relief or an exemption Rates for a single property You pay SDLT at these rates if, after buying the property, it is the only residential property you own. You will usually pay 5% on top of these rates if you own another residential property. Rates from 1 April 2025 Property or lease premium or transfer value SDLT rate Up to £125,000 Zero The next £125,000 (the portion from £125,001 to £250,000) 2% The next £675,000 (the portion from £250,001 to £925,000) 5% The next £575,000 (the portion from £925,001 to £1.5 million) 10% The remaining amount (the portion above £1.5 million) 12% Example In April 2025 you buy a house for £295,000. Stamp Duty Land Tax - Residential property rates You usually pay Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) on increasing portions of the property price when you buy residential property, for example a house or flat. The amount you pay depends on: • when you bought the property • how much you paid for it • whether you’re eligible for relief or an exemption Rates for a single property You pay SDLT at these rates if, after buying the property, it is the only residential property you own. You will usually pay 5% on top of these rates if you own another residential property. Rates from 1 April 2025 Property or lease premium or transfer value SDLT rate Up to £125,000 Zero The next £125,000 (the portion from £125,001 to £250,000) 2% The next £675,000 (the portion from £250,001 to £925,000) 5% The next £575,000 (the portion from £925,001 to £1.5 million) 10% The remaining amount (the portion above £1.5 million) 12% Example In April 2025 you buy a house for £295,000. results.summary: ***VIDEO TOUR AVAILABLE*** A stylishly presented THREE BEDROOM semi-detached home. Ideally situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in a highly sought-after residential area, just off Floyd Avenue in Chorlton. Both Chorlton Water Park and Chorlton Park on your doorstep. This property boasts a central location with excellent transport links to the City Centre and Manchester International Airport via nearby bus routes or the Metrolink on Mauldeth Road West. In brief, the well-planned accommodation consists of an entrance hallway opening to a lounge to the front, a spacious fitted kitchen, and a dining room with views into the rear enclosed lawned garden, completing the ground floor. To the first floor there is a landing leading to three good sized bedrooms and a three-piece shower room. The property benefits from a good-sized enclosed lawned garden with a private patio area and is warmed by gas fired central heating. Internal inspection is highly recommended. It’s perfectly positioned for easy access to the vibrant amenities of both West Didsbury and Chorlton, well-regarded local primary schools, Chorlton Golf Club, green open spaces, and the motorway network. Externally - To the front aspect the garden is enclosed by a low-level brick boundary wall and a paved path leads to the front door. A gate provides access to the generously sized rear garden, which is enclosed by timber panel fencing shared with neighbouring properties. The garden is predominantly lawned and features a practical timber shed, along with raised flower beds planted with a variety of shrubs and bushes. results.summary: The Property An attractive CHAIN FREE and well-maintained two-bedroom semi-detached home, positioned on a peaceful residential road with open views across nearby woodland. The property forms part of a private, enclosed development with no through traffic, offering a quiet and secure setting. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a generous living room, and a bright kitchen-diner fitted with a modern kitchen suite including dishwasher. Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a stylish modern bathroom. The home benefits from double glazing throughout and gas central heating. Outside, the rear garden enjoys a sunny southerly aspect and provides ample outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining. To the front is a low-maintenance garden and a driveway offering off-road parking for up to two vehicles. The property is ideally located within the catchment area of the popular Crossacres School. Excellent transport links are close by, with the Metrolink tram stop within walking distance, providing direct access to Manchester Airport and the city centre. Heald Green train station is also nearby, offering a fast, non-stop service to Manchester at peak times. The popular villages of Styal and Wilmslow are just a short drive away, offering a range of shops, cafés, and scenic countryside walks. An excellent opportunity for first-time buyers or investors alike. results.summary: This beautifully presented semi detached home is located in the heart of Prestwich Village, offering the perfect blend of period charm and modern convenience. The property boasts an array of original features and also includes elegant feature sash windows throughout, which flood the interiors with natural light and provide a timeless character. Upon entering via the open porch and hallway you are welcomed by a spacious lounge that features a striking multi burner and a graceful bay window, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. Adjacent to the lounge is a versatile dining or sitting room, enhanced by a feature living flame gas coal fire, making it a cosy retreat for family gatherings or more formal occasions. The modern fitted breakfast kitchen is thoughtfully designed, providing ample workspace with granite work surfaces, incorporating a breakfast bar, free standing range style cooker is includes as well as an integrated dishwasher and fridge/freezer, patio door onto the garden and access to cellar. The adjoining utility room and ground floor WC add further practicality for every-day living. For those seeking additional space, the cellar offers excellent scope to convert (subject to building regulations), presenting an exciting opportunity to create a playroom, office, or further living accommodation to suit your needs. Upstairs, the property offers three spacious bedrooms, each well-proportioned and filled with light, with the principal bedroom benefitting from built in furniture and a feature cast iron fireplace. There is an en suite shower room for added privacy and convenience. The second large double bedroom also includes a cast iron fireplace and free standing wardrobes. The third double bedroom is currently used as an office. A well-appointed family bathroom and WC cater to the needs of a busy household, ensuring comfort for all. The property also benefits from a lawned rear garden with a patio and outhouses as well as a driveway to the front with parking for two cars, providing valuable off-road parking in this sought-after location. Offered with no onward chain, this superb home is ready for immediate occupation, making it an ideal choice for families, professionals, or anyone looking to enjoy the vibrant lifestyle and excellent amenities that Prestwich Village has to offer. With its blend of traditional features, generous living spaces, and modern touches, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly special home in one of the area’s most desirable locations. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and potential of this outstanding property. results.summary: Chain-free and unique three bedroom detached 1930s family home on Green Lane in Heaton Norris promising a wonderful blend of character and contemporary features throughout granting the best of both traditional and modern. Zoned for superb local schools including the reputable Norris Bank Primary literally ‘down the road’ and within walking distance to Heaton Moor Road, the property is sure to impress with internal viewings recommended. This section of Green Lane is ideally situated in the heart of the popular residential area of Heaton Norris, which is highly regarded for its reputable local schools, green spaces and excellent transport links via the M60 Ring Road and A6 into Manchester. The property also has easy access to Heaton Moor Road via Green Lane, which promises a wealth of bars, pubs and retail outlets. Norris Bank Primary School is also just a five minute walk from the front door of the home. Entering through the front, the property itself is briefly comprised of: entrance hallway featuring a 1930s-style door and stained glass windows as well as solid wood exposed stairs and understairs storage, a dining room to the front with characteristic bay window and feature fireplace as well as some original tiles to the hearth, a second reception room to the rear featuring a log burner underneath a charming beam and upon a solid hearth, integrated storage to the alcove on the left, and sliding doors onto the rear garden. The floor is completed by a galley-style contemporary kitchen including fitted units, a small breakfast bar, a range of appliances and a useful understairs cupboard that is plumbed-in for a washing machine. The ground floor enjoys a myriad of original features such as the floorboards and 1930s-style doors. Turning stairs to the first floor lead to two double bedrooms ideal for the growing family and a third bedroom currently utilised as a work-from-home space. This versatile room could also serve as a child’s bedroom. The family bath/shower room completes the floor with a modern four-piece suite and tiling. The majority of the first floor also enjoys original exposed floorboards adding to the charm of the home. Externally, there is off-street parking to the front running down the side of the home on the driveway as well as a small garden to the front. The rear garden is south-facing and enjoys the sun throughout the day. This space consists of a mixture of turf, paving and a small seating area behind the living room. There is also a useful shed providing external storage. This impressive three-storey townhouse presents a superb opportunity for families or professionals seeking spacious and versatile accommodation within easy reach of Manchester city centre. The property is offered with no onward chain and features four generously proportioned double bedrooms, ensuring ample space for restful retreats or flexible home office arrangements. Two of the bedrooms benefit from contemporary en suite shower rooms, while a well-appointed family bathroom and a convenient guests WC serve the remaining areas, providing excellent comfort and privacy for both residents and visitors. The layout is thoughtfully designed, with a spacious modern fitted kitchen and dining area forming the heart of the home, ideal for both every-day living and entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with fitted wall and base units and some integrated appliances, and plentiful workspace, making it a pleasure for any culinary enthusiast. There is also a versatile snug and lounge, which includes a kitchenette and could easily serve as a fifth bedroom, playroom, or additional reception space depending on your needs. Throughout the property, neutral décor and quality finishes create a bright and inviting atmosphere, while large windows ensure an abundance of natural light. Practical features include a garage and parking, offering secure storage and peace of mind for vehicles or bicycles. The townhouse is conveniently situated with easy access to Manchester’s vibrant centre meaning that a wealth of shops, restaurants, cultural attractions, and transport links are all within easy reach. Whether you are commuting for work, exploring local amenities, or seeking a comfortable and stylish family home, this property represents an excellent choice. With no onward chain, the purchase process is streamlined and straightforward, allowing for a smooth transition to your new home. This modern townhouse is a rare find, offering generous space, flexible living options, and a highly sought-after location, making it a must-see for discerning buyers. Additional Information The vendor informs us the property is Freehold built in 2006 (Subject to solicitors confirmation) Council Tax Band C Gas fired central heating Auctioneers Additional Comments Auctioneers Additional Comments Pattinson Auction are working in Partnership with the marketing agent on this online auction sale and are referred to below as 'The Auctioneer'. This auction lot is being sold either under conditional (Modern) or unconditional (Traditional) auction terms and overseen by the auctioneer in partnership with the marketing agent. The property is available to be viewed strictly by appointment only via the Marketing Agent or The Auctioneer. Bids can be made via the Marketing Agents or via The Auctioneers website. Please be aware that any enquiry, bid or viewing of the subject property will require your details being shared between both any marketing agent and The Auctioneer in order that all matters can be dealt with effectively. The property is being sold via a transparent online auction. In order to submit a bid upon any property being marketed by The Auctioneer, all bidders/buyers will be required to adhere to a verification of identity process in accordance with Anti Money Laundering procedures. Bids can be submitted at any time and from anywhere. Our verification process is in place to ensure that AML procedure are carried out in accordance with the law. The advertised price is commonly referred to as a ‘Starting Bid’ or ‘Guide Price’ and is accompanied by a ‘Reserve Price’. The ‘Reserve Price’ is confidential to the seller and the auctioneer and will typically be within a range above or below 10% of the ‘Guide Price’ / ‘Starting Bid’. These prices are subject to change. An auction can be closed at any time with the auctioneer permitting for the property (the lot) to be sold prior to the end of the auction. A Legal Pack associated with this particular property is available to view upon request and contains details relevant to the legal documentation enabling all interested parties to make an informed decision prior to bidding. The Legal Pack will also outline the buyers’ obligations and sellers’ commitments. It is strongly advised that you seek the counsel of a solicitor prior to proceeding with any property and/or Land Title purchase. Auctioneers Additional Comments In order to secure the property and ensure commitment from the seller, upon exchange of contracts the successful bidder will be expected to pay a non-refundable deposit equivalent to 5% of the purchase price of the property. The deposit will be a contribution to the purchase price. A non-refundable reservation fee of up to 6% inc VAT (subject to a minimum of £7,200 inc VAT) is also required to be paid upon agreement of sale. The Reservation Fee is in addition to the agreed purchase price and consideration should be made by the purchaser in relation to any Stamp Duty Land Tax liability associated with overall purchase costs. Both the Marketing Agent and The Auctioneer may believe necessary or beneficial to the customer to pass their details to third party service suppliers, from which a referral fee may be obtained. There is no requirement or indeed obligation to use these recommended suppliers or services. The contemporary Pronorm kitchen is fitted with handle-less wall and base mounted units finished with a Quartz worktop and splashback. Integrated Bosch appliances including induction hob, oven, microwave, fridge freezer, dishwasher, undermount sink with chrome mixer tap and a freestanding Indesit washer/dryer is included in a separate utility cupboard. The apartment is fitted with luxury vinyl flooring throughout the living, kitchen and utility areas, fitted carpets to the bedrooms and Porcelain floor tiles to the bathrooms. Both double bedrooms have contemporary white fitted wardrobes and full height windows with views of the private residents garden. The main bedroom has a lovely en-suite bathroom, featuring a walk-in rain shower with fixed shower screen, Vitra white wall hung basin and toilet with Hansgrohe brassware, partially ceramic tiled walls, mirrored bathroom cabinet with LED downlighters above sink, heated towel rail and recessed LED spot lighting. The generous stylish main bathroom is fitted with Vitra white wall hung basin and toilet with Hansgrohe brassware, white enamel bath with Hansgrohe shower overhead, fixed shower screen, partially ceramic tiled walls, mirrored bathroom cabinet with LED downlighters above sink, heated towel rail and recessed LED spot lighting. results.summary: Asia House is an early 20th century packing and shipping warehouse built between 1906 and 1909 in an Edwardian Baroque style. Converted in 2003 it still retains the "exceptionally rich" entrance hall and stairwell, "lined with veined marble and green and cream faience, with designs of trees and Art Nouveau stained glass". Located in the heart of Manchester city centre and once housing Noel Gallagher from Oasis, residents of Asia House are within walking distance to Sackville Park, Canal Street, China Town, co-working spaces around the corner at Whitworth Lock or Clockwise Linley House, coffee shops including Foundation or Pollen at Kampus, and JD gym. The property is less than a five minute walk to Oxford Road or Piccadilly Train Station. Internally, this second floor apartment benefits from high ceilings and original features throughout. Property briefly comprises: entrance/hallway; open plan lounge diner with large windows bright corner aspect; `u` shaped kitchen; double bedroom; bathroom. The property is sold with vacant possession, a secure allocated car parking space and is offered chain free. Positioned just a short journey from Manchester city centre, this home is perfectly suited for professionals and city dwellers alike. Internally, the apartment features a welcoming hallway, an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area with access to a private balcony offering urban views. The layout also includes a separate reception space, ideal for remote working or relaxation, a well-proportioned bedroom, and a modern fitted bathroom. This property also enjoys excellent proximity to several of Manchester's leading higher education institutions, including the University of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University, both accessible via public transport in under half an hour. With great local amenities, a wealth of cultural landmarks and strong transport links to nearby towns including Trafford, Sale, and Stockport, this apartment offers a superb opportunity to embrace modern city living. Book your viewing at the earliest opportunity to avoid missing out. Cladding works are underway and are fully funded, with works due to commence in 2025. Following recent announcements from six major lenders confirming they are beginning to offer mortgages on buildings over 18 metres without the requirement for an EWS1 form, we are pleased to invite interest from mortgage buyers. Prospective purchasers are advised to seek guidance from their mortgage lender or speak with the branch directly to discuss individual lending criteria. Premium Fast Sale The innovative Premium Fast Sale Plus method from Springbok Properties is a secure and straightforward way to buy property. It works like a typical sale, with a number of added benefits to the buyer. Benefits o Carefully implemented security measures o A speedy process o Realistically priced properties o A Buy it Now option (ask for further information on this feature from our advisors) o A significantly reduced chance of fall-throughs o No risk of being "gazumped" o The full focus of our highly motivated team Springbok Properties' Premium Fast Sale Plus puts you in the driving seat thanks to our fast and secure methods. All properties are competitively priced and carefully managed by motivated sellers for a quick, stress-free transaction. Deposit Sales can be secured with a reservation deposit of £2,500. This forms part of the final purchase price and is NOT an extra cost. This deposit ensures that the property is taken off the market as soon as a sale is agreed. It is then exclusively reserved for you, eliminating gazumping, time wasting and financial loss. An administration fee of £396 is required in order to draw up an exclusive legally binding contract between the buyer and seller. This gives the buyer exclusive rights to purchase within a pre-agreed timeframe. Exclusivity Following the payment of the above amount, Springbok Properties will facilitate a fixed exclusivity period (approximately 12 weeks). The adjoining kitchen offers good worktop and storage space for everyday use. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, along with a modern family bathroom accessed from the central hallway. Well placed for local amenities, transport links and nearby green spaces, the property offers comfortable living within easy reach of Stockport town centre and surrounding areas. Early viewing is recommended. This property is offered for sale via the Online Modern Method of Auction, a flexible and buyer-friendly way to purchase. Buyers have 56 working days to exchange and complete from receipt of the draft contract, or 10 working days after payment of the Buyer’s Premium, whichever is earlier. This timescale allows buyers to proceed with traditional residential finance. If the auction is successful, or the vendor accepts an offer during the auction, the buyer will be required to pay a non-refundable Buyer’s Premium, securing the property and removing it from the market. Buyers must agree to the auction terms and conditions before solicitors are instructed. Full details are available on the GOTO Auctions website or via Purplebricks. Please note the property is subject to an undisclosed Reserve Price, typically no more than 10% above the Starting Bid. Prices are subject to change. To book a viewing, visit Purplebricks. General Information A Buyer’s Premium of 3.6% of the purchase price plus VAT applies (minimum £6,600 plus VAT), along with a Legal Pack fee of £396 including VAT. These fees are payable in addition to the purchase price and may be considered for Stamp Duty Land Tax calculations. Buyers should seek advice from their legal representative. General Information – Auctioneer’s Comments The Modern Method of Auction does not require exchange on the fall of the hammer. Instead, buyers are given time to complete the transaction, allowing for mortgage arrangements. The Buyer’s Premium secures the property during the Reservation Period. All terms, conditions and the Reservation Form are available within the Legal Pack. Material Information Information provided by the vendor, agent and GOTO Group may not be fully verified. Buyers should refer to the Legal Pack, available once registered, and carry out their own due diligence before proceeding. Property Description Disclaimer This is a general description of the property only, and is not intended to constitute part of an offer or contract. It has been verified by the seller(s), unless marked as 'draft'. Purplebricks conducts some valuations online and some of our customers prepare their own property descriptions, so if you decide to proceed with a viewing or an offer, please note this information may have been provided solely by the vendor, and we may not have been able to visit the property to confirm it. If you require clarification on any point then please contact us, especially if you’re traveling some distance to view. All information should be checked by your solicitor prior to exchange of contracts. Successful buyers will be required to complete anti-money laundering and proof of funds checks. Our partner, Lifetime Legal Limited, will carry out the initial checks on our behalf. The current non-refundable cost is £80 inc. VAT per offer. You’ll need to pay this to Lifetime Legal and complete all checks before we can issue a memorandum of sale. The cost includes obtaining relevant data and any manual checks and monitoring which might be required, and includes a range of benefits. Purplebricks will receive some of the fee taken by Lifetime Legal to compensate for its role in providing these checks.
