Its unique location means you can enjoy the peaceful setting and open green space of the Irk Valley, but with the high-quality retail and leisure offer of Manchester City Centre only 20 minutes' walk away. Collyhurst is an ideal place to call home for families due to the tight knit community and choice of schools in the area. The location is well served by public transport with several bus and rail routes to and from the city centre. Collyhurst Village is one of the first phases of Victoria North, the North of England's biggest regeneration project. Victoria North is set to create 15,000 new homes across 155 hectares and seven neighbourhoods over the next 20 years, helping with the shortfall in housing in Manchester. The redevelopment project will create better-connected public spaces, new and improved transport links, and more homes, parks and retail spaces for the city's growing population. Situated in a highly desirable area of South Swinton in a fantastic position close to the border of Worsley and Monton, the property enjoys excellent access to local amenities and superb transport links. Families are particularly well catered for, with a range of well-regarded schools nearby, including Broadoak Primary School (Outstanding) within walking distance. This is a standout home offering space, quality and location in equal measure—early viewing is highly recommended. results.summary: Rare-to-the-market three bedroom 1960s family home on the cul-de-sac of Beaminster Avenue in Heaton Mersey in a contemporary condition internally and boasting some of the most enviable rear views in the Heatons over the allotments that will naturally appeal to first-time buyer couples and families alike. Zoned for the best local schools and within walking distance to Priestnall and Tithe Barn, early viewings come highly recommended to avoid disappointment. Beaminster Avenue is a little-known but ideally-situated cul-de-sac in the desirable residential area of Heaton Mersey, being within catchment areas for reputable local primary and secondary schools and within walking distance to Heaton Moor Road with its wealth of bars, pubs and retail outlets. Transport links are also readily available with the M60 trunk road, East Didsbury Metrolink and Heaton Chapel Rail station all within easy reach. Entering through the entrance hallway, the property itself is briefly comprised of: sun room directly to the right current used as a play room, a dining space in the former garage that could serve a variety of purposes, an internal sitting room, a galley-style kitchen to the rear including fitted units along both sides, and the largest of the living/sitting rooms to the rear featuring patio doors onto the rear garden. The current owners have retained and maintained the original wooden parquet flooring in the entrance hall and sitting room, which further extends underneath the existing carpet in the living room to the rear – a superb original feature that blends well with the contemporary conveniences. Single flight stairs to the first floor grant access to three double bedrooms – ideal for the growing family and something of a rarity in local three bed houses – and a family bath/shower room comprised of a contemporary four-piece suite. Externally, there is ample off-street parking on the front driveway for at least two vehicles. To the rear, the garden is comprised of a mixture of turf and flags. results.summary: Berry & George Estates was set up to make selling and buying your home easier - plain and simple. Unlike most agents, we're available 7 days a week, including out of hours, because that's when people actually need us! Read our glowing Google Reviews, left by real people, like you! If you need help with a mortgage, speak to Beth at Love Mortgages, she's Award Winning and voted Mortgage Broker of the Year three years running - and yes, the advice is free. Just Google 'LoveMortgages Mold' and check out the reviews for yourself.. Firstly, I just want to point out that this home has a rare 'A' Rated Energy Performance Certificate, which has been achieved through the installation of solar panels that provide free daytime electricity. There is also a modern air-source heat pump system, with retrofitted cavity wall insulation, of which none of this was standard when built and has been added at great expense to the present owners. This home is basically a blank canvass for you to come in and alter to exactly how 'you like', and it's priced just so that you can do this! There is an undeniable cache to being able to live in, or at least near to a thriving metropolitan city, but all too often these locations carry hidden disadvantages, so it is best to think carefully before committing yourself. Happily though, this particular home manages to encapsulate many of the good points of living near the centre of the action, while avoiding the less desirable ones and does so with panache. Who, when weighing up the pros and cons of big city living, would think that such a home could be found within easy reach of a nature reserve and still only a short tram ride away from the beating heart of this amazing city? Well not me for a start, so let's see what all the fuss is about. Situated on what I would hesitate to call an estate, because the term carries visions of rows of identical dwellings which blend into one another denying any sense of individuality, it almost sits on an island, sandwiched between the main A6044, the canal bank and a large wooded area giving a very 'country' feeling that can come as a surprise. Yes, there are pockets of industry locally, but these are never intrusive and indeed can be largely ignored as a necessary evil because after all, how can a big city exist without them? A large open plan lawn lies to the front of the home, beside which a driveway passes between this house and next door, to the detached garage at the rear. A small canopy type porch offers protection to visitors leaning on the bell, or even the more determined carol singers. Stepping into the hallway, it's a great place to store your shoes and coats. Stairs rise in front of us, and a door to our right reveals the formal dining room. This is a large and comfortable space, where its attractive and practical ceramic tiled floor continues through and into the kitchen area. Yes, this is in fact a dining/kitchen, but before you imagine a deeply compromised space with insufficient room to fulfil either role adequately, look again, and you will appreciate the scale of the place. A full sized six seat table is swallowed easily with room left for any additional furniture that you may fancy, and nothing here encroaches into the kitchen area at all. Speaking of the kitchen, this large space features high and low level fitted units to three sides while leaving a place in the centre that could even accommodate an island, should you wish, though with the storage and work top space currently on offer, I doubt it would be necessary. All the expected 21st century technology is present and correct, making life as simple as it can ever be when catering for a hungry family who also wear clothes and presumably create laundry. Set in the side wall is a the 'back' door, opening onto the driveway at the side of the home while opposite this, another door takes us back into the home and past the downstairs cloakroom. This is a very generously sized room, as far as a cloakroom goes, and contains all of the usual suspects that you'd expect to find. There's a pedestal hand basin and lavatory, as well as a frosted window that lets the light flow in and keeps any prying eyes out.....not that its that kind of area. Returning to the main hallway, the first door off the hall opens into the main lounge. This is a large and comfortable space which places little restraint upon you when choosing your furniture, because this will accommodate any style or size you select. The main focal point of the room is provided by a stylish faux marble fire surround, where a living flame electric fire may be a welcome addition. The light in here comes from a set of sliding patio doors that open into the attached Conservatory/Orangery, though to call it that is selling it short. It has been fitted with a solid roof and so it becomes more of an additional living space suited for all year-round use. Currently it's being used as a playroom, but what you want to use it for, well that's for you to decide....and isn't life all about choices? From the Conservatory/Orangery, you can appreciate the fully enclosed garden where energetic children can run off steam, and doubtless will, on the soft play surface. However, when the little darlings have run themselves to a standstill and retired to bed, it then gives the adults in the home, somewhere to sit in peace as the light fades with the increasingly necessary draughts of alcohol. Completely enclosed and pretty private, this garden is a 'busy person's dream. Low maintenance, and then there is an open, wooden outbuilding that currently houses a hot tub - but again, what you decide to use it for is up to you. Moving back through the home to the hallway we pass the bottom of the stairs and come to the hall's last remaining door. This reveals a room that helps provide much of the flexibility to be found here; overlooking the front lawn, it is the perfect size and location for a man/woman-cave, music room or even, for those condemned to working for a living, a splendid home office. Climbing the stairs to the landing brings us face to face with the family bathroom. Pleasingly presented and in excellent condition it houses a pedestal hand basin, lavatory and traditional bath fitted with a glass side screen to protect the body of the room from any over-enthusiastic use of the shower above. The shower is of the type which draws its hot water directly from the home's heating system, eliminating the twin problems of feeble pressure and inconsistent temperature, which can only be a good thing. Adjacent to here, the first of the bedrooms can be seen as either a luxuriously proportioned single room or, thanks in no small measure to the large fitted wardrobe and the space it offers, a compact but perfectly comfortable double. Moving towards the front of the home takes us to the principal bedroom, an altogether different kettle of fish. This is a large and well appointed room featuring not one, but two fitted wardrobes, which in turn frees up sufficient space for additional furniture if required. We then come to the very handy en-suite with its pedestal hand basin, lavatory and walk-in shower cubicle. Retracing our steps along the landing and past the head of the staircase we come to the remaining bedrooms. The first and largest, of which rivals the principal for space and not fittings, having to make do with only one fitted wardrobe (shame...) though this is hardly an imposition. The final bedroom, like the first, is possibly best suited for use as a single, although a small double could fit in if necessary. Whatever use you choose to put it to, it adds the finishing touch to this capable, flexible and rather lovely family home. That fact that you have solar panels providing free electric during the day, an EPC 'A' rating with a recently acquired air-source heat pump and Cavity wall insulation, means that the rising energy bills that us, mere mortals are facing, shouldn't be giving you sleepless nights....now surely that's worth its weight in gold.... Useful information: COUNCIL TAX BAND: E (Salford) ELECTRIC & GAS BILLS: TBC SOLAR PANELS: TBC WATER BILL: TBC Please note there is an annual estate maintenance charge of approximately £180 PA Photos are taken with a WIDE ANGLE CAMERA so PLEASE LOOK at the 2D floor plans for approximate room sizes, as we don't want you turning up at the home and being disappointed, courtesy of planstosell.co.uk: All in all this home manages to pull off the very clever balancing act of providing four bedrooms and spacious living accommodation in a modern suburban setting, while retaining an indefinable sense of character, and it is this that makes it something of a rarity. It is in excellent condition, just waiting for you to put your own stamp on it, with the sort of transport links essential to modern living and best of all, it is realistically priced, and let's not forget the 'A' rated EPC, Air-Source Heat Pump and the Solar Panels and Cavity wall insulation......so give Berry and George a call today, it'll be the best thing you do all day...unless you're a film star, racing driver etc, in which case, it'll be the 2nd best thing you do! Some of the items mentioned in it may not be included in the final guide price and may not be completely accurate - so please check with the owners before making an offer. Measurements: These approximate room sizes are only intended as general guidance. You must verify the dimensions carefully before ordering carpets or any built-in furniture. 4. Services: Please note we have not tested the services or any of the equipment or appliances in this property, accordingly we strongly advise prospective buyers to commission their own survey or service reports before finalising their offer to purchase. 5. Anti Money Laundering - Note - To be able to sell or purchase a property in the United Kingdom all agents have a legal requirement to conduct Identity checks on all customers involved in the transaction to fulfil their obligations under Anti Money Laundering regulations. We outsource this check to a third party and a charge will apply. Ask the branch for further details. 6. UNAUTHORISED COPY OF THESE SALES PARTICULARS OR PHOTOGRAPHS WILL RESULT IN PROSECUTION - PLEASE ASK BERRY & GEORGE LTD FOR PERMISSION AS WE OWN THE RIGHTS! Yes, this is in fact a dining/kitchen, but before you imagine a deeply compromised space with insufficient room to fulfil either role adequately, look again, and you will appreciate the scale of the place. A full sized six seat table is swallowed easily with room left for any additional furniture that you may fancy, and nothing here encroaches into the kitchen area at all. Speaking of the kitchen, this large space features high and low level fitted units to three sides while leaving a place in the centre that could even accommodate an island, should you wish, though with the storage and work top space currently on offer, I doubt it would be necessary. All the expected 21st century technology is present and correct, making life as simple as it can ever be when catering for a hungry family who also wear clothes and presumably create laundry. Set in the side wall is a the 'back' door, opening onto the driveway at the side of the home while opposite this, another door takes us back into the home and past the downstairs cloakroom. This is a very generously sized room, as far as a cloakroom goes, and contains all of the usual suspects that you'd expect to find. There's a pedestal hand basin and lavatory, as well as a frosted window that lets the light flow in and keeps any prying eyes out.....not that its that kind of area. Returning to the main hallway, the first door off the hall opens into the main lounge. This is a large and comfortable space which places little restraint upon you when choosing your furniture, because this will accommodate any style or size you select. The main focal point of the room is provided by a stylish faux marble fire surround, where a living flame electric fire may be a welcome addition. The light in here comes from a set of sliding patio doors that open into the attached Conservatory/Orangery, though to call it that is selling it short. It has been fitted with a solid roof and so it becomes more of an additional living space suited for all year-round use. Currently it's being used as a playroom, but what you want to use it for, well that's for you to decide....and isn't life all about choices? From the Conservatory/Orangery, you can appreciate the fully enclosed garden where energetic children can run off steam, and doubtless will, on the soft play surface. However, when the little darlings have run themselves to a standstill and retired to bed, it then gives the adults in the home, somewhere to sit in peace as the light fades with the increasingly necessary draughts of alcohol. Completely enclosed and pretty private, this garden is a 'busy person's dream. Low maintenance, and then there is an open, wooden outbuilding that currently houses a hot tub - but again, what you decide to use it for is up to you. Moving back through the home to the hallway we pass the bottom of the stairs and come to the hall's last remaining door. This reveals a room that helps provide much of the flexibility to be found here; overlooking the front lawn, it is the perfect size and location for a man/woman-cave, music room or even, for those condemned to working for a living, a splendid home office. Climbing the stairs to the landing brings us face to face with the family bathroom. Pleasingly presented and in excellent condition it houses a pedestal hand basin, lavatory and traditional bath fitted with a glass side screen to protect the body of the room from any over-enthusiastic use of the shower above. The shower is of the type which draws its hot water directly from the home's heating system, eliminating the twin problems of feeble pressure and inconsistent temperature, which can only be a good thing. Adjacent to here, the first of the bedrooms can be seen as either a luxuriously proportioned single room or, thanks in no small measure to the large fitted wardrobe and the space it offers, a compact but perfectly comfortable double. Moving towards the front of the home takes us to the principal bedroom, an altogether different kettle of fish. This is a large and well appointed room featuring not one, but two fitted wardrobes, which in turn frees up sufficient space for additional furniture if required. We then come to the very handy en-suite with its pedestal hand basin, lavatory and walk-in shower cubicle. Retracing our steps along the landing and past the head of the staircase we come to the remaining bedrooms. The first and largest, of which rivals the principal for space and not fittings, having to make do with only one fitted wardrobe (shame...) though this is hardly an imposition. The final bedroom, like the first, is possibly best suited for use as a single, although a small double could fit in if necessary. Whatever use you choose to put it to, it adds the finishing touch to this capable, flexible and rather lovely family home. That fact that you have solar panels providing free electric during the day, an EPC 'A' rating with a recently acquired air-source heat pump and Cavity wall insulation, means that the rising energy bills that us, mere mortals are facing, shouldn't be giving you sleepless nights....now surely that's worth its weight in gold.... results.summary: Welcome to Broadstone Hall Road South, Reddish — a truly captivating, extended period bay-fronted mid-terrace home that effortlessly blends timeless character with contemporary living, presented in immaculate condition throughout. From the very first approach, this charming home hints at the elegance within. Step through the front door and you are instantly welcomed into a beautifully proportioned living room, where a large bay window draws in an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. This is a space designed for comfort and calm — whether you’re unwinding after a long day, enjoying your favorite film, or simply losing yourself in a good book, the room offers the perfect retreat from the outside world. As you move further through the property, the home truly begins to reveal its magic. The rear of the house opens up into a spectacular open-plan kitchen and dining area — the true heart and soul of the home. Thoughtfully extended and designed with modern living in mind, this space is nothing short of show-stopping. Expansive bi-fold doors stretch across the rear, allowing natural light to pour in while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. In the warmer months, these doors can be fully opened to create a wonderful flow into the garden, perfect for entertaining. The kitchen itself is both stylish and functional, featuring sleek fitted units and a central island that naturally becomes a social hub — imagine friends gathered around with a glass of wine while meals are prepared, conversations flowing as easily as the evening unfolds. Whether hosting elegant dinner parties, lively family gatherings, or relaxed weekend brunches, this versatile space adapts beautifully to every occasion. Step outside and you’ll find a stunning, landscaped south-facing garden — a private haven designed for both relaxation and entertainment. From summer barbecues and al fresco dining to quiet mornings with a coffee or peaceful afternoons spent reading in the sunshine, this outdoor space is a true extension of the home. Upstairs, the sense of space continues. The impressive principal bedroom is generously sized, easily accommodating a super king-sized bed along with ample wardrobe space and even a dedicated area for a desk — ideal for modern lifestyles. The second bedroom, overlooking the rear, offers flexibility as a guest room, nursery, or stylish home office. Completing the upper floor is a sleek and contemporary bathroom, finished to a high standard and designed as a calming sanctuary — the perfect place to unwind and wash away the stresses of the day. Beyond the home itself, the location is equally appealing. Situated within walking distance of highly regarded local schools and just a short stroll from the natural beauty of Reddish Vale Country Park, this property offers the perfect balance of convenience and lifestyle. This is more than just a house — it’s a home where period charm meets modern sophistication, a place where memories are made and everyday living feels just that little bit more special. If you are searching for a property that truly stands out from the crowd, this exceptional home is sure to exceed your expectations. results.summary: Spacious Double Extended South Swinton Home…Situated on the ever-popular Sheringham Drive in South Swinton, this attractive double-extended semi-detached home offers spacious, well-balanced accommodation in a highly desirable residential setting. Set back from the road, the property enjoys excellent kerb appeal with a generous driveway providing off-street parking for multiple vehicles. The red-brick frontage is well maintained and welcoming. To the rear, a fully enclosed garden offers a safe and private outdoor space, mainly laid to lawn with fenced boundaries, a patio area ideal for summer seating and entertaining, and a useful storage shed. The impressive double-storey rear extension significantly enhances both the ground and first floor living space while maintaining a balanced outdoor area. Internally, the home extends to approximately 76.5 square metres (823.4 square feet) and is presented in a clean, neutral décor throughout, ready for a new owner to personalise. A welcoming entrance hallway provides access to the principal rooms, staircase to the first floor and useful under-stairs storage, along with the added benefit of a convenient ground floor WC. The living room is bright and comfortable, centred around an attractive feature fireplace and enhanced by large front and rear-facing windows allowing plenty of natural light. To the rear, the spacious kitchen diner forms the heart of the home. Fitted with modern wall and base units, contrasting work surfaces and ample appliance space, it comfortably accommodates a family dining table and enjoys pleasant views over the garden — perfect for everyday family life and entertaining. Upstairs, the landing leads to three well-proportioned bedrooms and a contemporary shower room. The main bedroom benefits from the rear extension and fitted wardrobes, offering excellent built-in storage and generous floor space. A second double bedroom provides further flexibility, while the third bedroom is ideal as a child's room, nursery or home office. The modern shower room features a walk-in enclosure, vanity wash basin and WC, finished in neutral tiling and filled with natural light. The loft is boarded and fitted with lighting, providing additional practical storage. Located on the ever-popular Sheringham Drive in South Swinton, this property enjoys a highly desirable residential setting, well regarded for its family-friendly environment and excellent connectivity. Close to Monton Village, excellent transport links via the A580 and highly regarded schools including The Deans Primary and Moorside High School, this Freehold home combines location, space and lifestyle appeal — ideal for first-time buyers and growing families alike. Additional Information The property is Freehold and falls under Salford Local Authority, with a Council Tax Band B and an annual charge of approximately £1,907. The home has an Energy Performance Certificate rating of C and offers a total floor area of approximately 76.5 square metres (823.4 square feet). Heating is provided via a gas combi boiler, installed in 2015, which was last serviced in October 2025, with the installation certificate available. The street is publicly maintained and adopted by Salford Council. The property benefits from a double rear extension, with planning permission granted, and offers off-street parking. The loft is boarded and fitted with lighting. Michigan Point is a striking apartment complex that has proven hugely popular with Manchester and Salford's growing working professional populace. Briefly, the property comprises of an entrance hallway, with access to a bright open plan living and kitchen space. with the kitchen benefitting from integrated appliances. Further, there is a double bedroom and a modern three piece suite bathroom. Externally, there is also an allocated parking space included. results.summary: THREE BEDROOM SEMI DETACHED PROPERTY IN A SOUGHT AFTER LOCATION Located on High Bank Road in the charming area of Pendlebury, Swinton, Manchester, this delightful detached house offers a perfect blend of comfort and modern living. With three generously sized double bedrooms, this property is ideal for families or those seeking extra space. Upon entering, you are welcomed into a spacious lounge that provides a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. The modern kitchen is well-equipped and designed for convenience, making meal preparation a pleasure. Additionally, the property features a downstairs WC, adding to the practicality of the home. One of the standout features of this property is the large, low-maintenance rear garden. This outdoor space is perfect for enjoying sunny days, hosting barbecues, or simply unwinding in a tranquil setting. The garden offers ample room for children to play or for gardening enthusiasts to cultivate their green thumb. The family bathroom is well-appointed, ensuring that all members of the household have access to comfortable facilities. With plenty of storage options throughout the home, you will find it easy to keep your living space tidy and organised. This property is not just a house; it is a place where you can create lasting memories. results.summary: A rare opportunity has arisen to acquire a fantastic ground floor apartment within the highly regarded Lea Court, perfectly positioned in the very heart of Heaton Moor. Arguably one of the finest apartments to come to market within the development, homes of this calibre seldom become available, and early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and lifestyle on offer. 760 square feet. The property is accessed via an inviting communal entrance that leads into a welcoming private hallway. From here, double doors open into an impressive living space measuring approximately 20ft by 17ft, creating a striking first impression. This beautifully proportioned room provides generous space for freestanding furniture and is enhanced by a stylish media feature wall, offering a contemporary focal point. A Juliet balcony overlooks the well-maintained communal gardens, allowing natural light to flood the room and providing a pleasant outlook. Flowing seamlessly from the living area, the open-plan dining and kitchen space forms the true centrepiece of the home, perfectly suited to both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is fitted with a range of modern units complemented by quality work surfaces, creating a sleek yet practical environment. A selection of integrated appliances has been thoughtfully incorporated, ensuring the space is as functional as it is stylish. The contemporary bathroom is finished to an excellent standard and features a modern three-piece white suite, enhanced by elegant ironmongery, matching tiled flooring and stylish splash back areas that add to the overall sense of refinement. Both bedrooms are generously sized doubles, offering comfortable and versatile accommodation that completes the interior of this superb apartment. Each room has been designed to provide a relaxing retreat while maintaining the high standard of presentation found throughout the property. Lea Court enjoys a highly desirable setting within easy walking distance of Heaton Chapel Train Station and the A6, making it an excellent choice for commuters. The vibrant cafés, restaurants and boutique shops that make Heaton Moor so popular are quite literally on the doorstep, offering a lively yet convenient lifestyle. Externally, the development benefits from attractive communal gardens that provide a pleasant green outlook for residents to enjoy. The property also comes with the added advantage of a sheltered, allocated parking space, further enhancing the practicality of this exceptional home. results.summary: Ideal First-Time Buy…Situated on a quiet and well-established residential street in the popular Clifton area of Swinton, Malcolm Avenue is a well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached home offering a practical and versatile layout, generous outdoor space and excellent connectivity. The property is held on a freehold basis and will appeal to a wide range of buyers, particularly first-time buyers, young families and those looking to downsize without compromising on space or location. To the front, the home is set back behind a lawned garden and benefits from a brick-paved double driveway, providing convenient off-road parking. On entering the property, a welcoming hallway leads through to the main living accommodation and staircase rising to the first floor. The front-facing living room is a bright and comfortable space, centred around a feature fireplace and offering an ideal setting for everyday family living. To the rear, the property opens into a spacious dining area, creating a natural hub of the home with ample room for a family dining table and entertaining. This flows seamlessly into the conservatory, which provides a versatile additional reception space enjoying views over the rear garden. French doors open directly onto the decked terrace, making it an excellent spot for relaxing or hosting during warmer months. The fitted kitchen is well laid out with a range of wall and base units, complementary work surfaces, integrated cooking appliances and space for freestanding white goods, with direct access to the conservatory and garden beyond. The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous main bedroom with fitted storage, a second comfortable double bedroom and a third bedroom ideal for a child's room, nursery or home office. The accommodation is completed by a family bathroom fitted with a white suite comprising a bath with shower over, wash basin and WC. Externally, the rear garden is a real highlight, featuring a large decked seating area leading onto a lawned garden with fenced boundaries and a detached shed for storage. The property is ideally positioned close to Clifton Country Park, offering scenic walks and open green space, while local shops, schools and Swinton town centre are all within easy reach. Excellent transport links include nearby access to the M60 motorway, regular bus services and Swinton train station, providing direct connections into Manchester city centre. Additional Information The property is freehold and falls under Salford Local Authority, with Council Tax Band A and an annual charge of £1,635. The accommodation extends to approximately 74.5 square metres (801.91 square feet), with the Energy Performance Certificate is rated D. Heating is provided by a gas central heating system with a combi boiler, installed around five years ago and last serviced in 2025. FENSA certification is in place for replacement windows and doors, with five windows installed in December 2015 and one door installed in October 2015. The street is publicly maintained and adopted, with responsibility held by Salford Council. The roof has benefited from repair completed approximately one year ago. The loft is part boarded and accessed via a ladder, and externally the property offers a double driveway. Utilities include mains electricity, water and drainage, alongside fibre broadband to the street (FTTC). results.summary: Surrounded by green belt located within Simister Village is a 5 bedroom, 2 bathroom home with a huge south facing garden ready to move into! With convenient connections to the M60 network this house has been thoughtfully laid out to include an open plan snug/kitchen/breakfast room, a large lounge/dining space with a wood burner fireplace, & a huge garage/utility room all to the ground floor. Upstairs is a split landing opening out to the two separate sides of the house. The master suite has an ensuite and a Cathedral style window with balcony over looking the rear garden. 3 other double bedrooms and a single bedroom are serviced by the beautiful family bathroom with a ceiling light well. HALLWAY 6' 6" x 6' 6" (2.0m x 2.0m) Through the wooden/glazed front door you enter the cosy hallway with access to all living accommodation and the stairs to the first floor. An under stairs cloakroom provides plenty of storage and the stained glass landing windows flood natural light through. LIVING/DINING ROOM 22' 7" x 14' 1" (6.9m x 4.3m) Sunlight from the south facing garden comes through the main reception room which houses a wood burning fire. The windows have new plantation shutters fitted and the picture window at the rear frames a beautiful view of the huge rear garden. KITCHEN 17' 4" x 8' 10" (5.3m x 2.7m) The fully integrated kitchen flows effortlessly into the second reception room and has a breakfast bar to seat 3 people. The handle less doors under the stone worktop with glass splashback house integrated appliances which include a twin oven, gas hob with extraction over, a fridge/freezer, microwave and dishwasher. A boiler tap is fitted to give instant filtered boiler water for morning tea/coffee and the wooden window looks straight down the garden. SNUG ROOM 15' 1" x 12' 9" (4.6m x 3.9m) Bifold doors open out onto the raised decking patio and a remote controlled electric blind is fitted for cosy nights in. The snug room has a television point and is open plan from the kitchen so is great for entertaining when cooking especially on summer evenings with the doors wide open. GARAGE/UTILITY 16' 4" x 13' 1" (5.0m x 4.0m) Fitted with an up and over garage door this space doubles up as storage and utility room. The combination boiler is located here and has been serviced and recently overhauled. Both the gas and electricity meters are in the garage. A water filtration system is fitted to the water supply here so the whole house has filtered water even from the showers! The utility area has both hot and cold water. A side door leads into a small hallway between the garage and the snug, ideal for coming in from a muddy walk! MASTER BEDROOM 15' 1" x 13' 1" (4.6m x 4m) With a wall of fitted wardrobes and French doors opening up to a balcony the Master bedroom boasts endless natural light from the cathedral style window. the vaulted ceiling and access to the Ensuite shower room give a hotel feel throughout. ENSUITE 8' 2" x 5' 10" (2.5m x 1.8m) Fitted with a corner glass shower cubicle, sink unit mounted in a vanity cabinet and a hidden Wc the Ensuite shower room has two frosted glass windows, ceiling spot lights and is tiled throughout. BEDROOM 2 10' 5" x 9' 10" (3.2m x 3m) This large double bedroom overlooks the front aspect of the house and has space for wardrobes and dressing tables alongside a king sized bed. BEDROOM 3 10' 5" x 10' 5" (3.2m x 3.2m) Currently used as a home office this double bedroom has fitted wardrobes and desk space and overlooks the stunning rear garden. BEDROOM 4 10' 9" x 9' 10" (3.3m x 3m) Located at the front of the house bedroom 4 has fitted wardrobes and a desk and currently houses a single bed. BEDROOM 5 / STUDY 9' 10" x 5' 6" (3m x 1.7m) Ideal for a home office or nursery this bedroom overlooks the garden and is currently used as a home office. EXTERIOR Hidden behind the house is a glorious south facing garden with a raised decking area with stairs leading down to ground level. Outdoor security lighting is fitted at the front, side and rear. Well established plants and trees line both sides of the garden and a pathway leads to the bottom of the garden where a wooden shed and greenhouse are sited. The lawn gently slopes towards open fields and trees beyond. Perfect for a growing family and/or those with pets. To the front of the house is a the driveway which can fit 3 cars but offers drive on an off access for 2. Lights are fitted in the brick walled flower border and a motion sensor light is fitted over the front door. Stairs leading to the first-floor landing reveal three good sized double bedrooms, one benefitting from a bay window while the other offers an en-suite shower room, a white three-piece shower room complete this floor. To the second floor you will find an additional two double bedrooms both with sweeping views, and a white three-piece bathroom suite. This beautiful home benefits from gas fired central heating, a wood burning stove, high ceilings, picture rails and ceiling coving, ceiling roses, stripped and varnished floor boards, and a rear enclosed garden. Externally - To the front aspect there is a low-level brick boundary wall with a mature hedgerow above, a paved front garden and pathway leading to the front door. results.summary: A well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached family home, forming part of an attractive 1920s development and ideally positioned in the heart of Heaton Norris. The property enjoys close proximity to the cafes, shops and amenities of Heaton Chapel, as well as Heaton Chapel train station providing excellent transport links into Stockport, Manchester and the surrounding areas. The accommodation begins with a welcoming entrance hallway, complete with useful storage, leading through to a bright and spacious open-plan living and dining room. This excellent family space is filled with natural light and features French doors opening onto the rear garden, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. To the rear is a modern fitted kitchen offering attractive matching wall and base units along with ample work surface space. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including two generous double bedrooms and a third single room perfectly suited as a nursery, guest room or home office. These rooms are served by a three-piece family bathroom fitted with a bath and shower over. A useful and well-maintained single-chamber cellar provides valuable additional space and is currently utilised as a home office/games room alongside a separate utility area, adding further practicality to the home. Externally, the property is garden-fronted with low maintenance slate chippings. To the rear is a private enclosed garden mainly laid to lawn, ideal for relaxing and enjoying the warmer months. The property also benefits from on-street parking along a quiet one-way road. results.summary: Generous Family Space…Situated on a well-established residential street in the popular Seedley area of Salford, this attractive three-bedroom semi-detached home offers generous living space, charming character features and a south-facing rear garden, making it an excellent choice for families, first-time buyers or those looking to enjoy convenient access to Manchester. Externally, the property presents a welcoming frontage set behind decorative wrought iron gates and railings, with a paved driveway providing off-road parking alongside a neatly planted garden area with mature shrubs. A charming entrance porch adds character and practicality, while gated side access leads through to the rear garden. Inside, the property immediately feels bright and welcoming. The entrance hallway provides access to the main living areas and includes useful understairs storage. To the front of the home, the spacious living room is filled with natural light from a large bay window and features a brick fireplace with inset gas fire, creating a cosy focal point within the room. To the rear, the property opens into a generous kitchen and dining space, fitted with shaker-style units and ample worktop space, along with room for appliances. The dining area comfortably accommodates a family table and benefits from French doors opening directly onto the rear garden, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the landing leads to three well-proportioned bedrooms. The main bedroom enjoys a front-facing bay window and extensive fitted wardrobes with a built-in dressing area. A second double bedroom overlooks the rear garden and also benefits from fitted storage, while the third bedroom offers versatility as a nursery, guest room or home office. The accommodation is completed by a modern family bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite and contemporary tiling. To the rear, the property enjoys a large south-facing garden, mainly laid to lawn and bordered by mature trees and hedging, providing a private and leafy setting. Patio seating areas create space for outdoor dining and relaxation, while the depth of the garden offers excellent potential for further landscaping or outdoor living. The location is ideal, with Buile Hill Park nearby, along with convenient access to Salford Royal Hospital, Salford Quays and Manchester city centre via the M602 and local transport links. Well-regarded schools including St Luke's CE Primary and All Hallows RC High School are also within easy reach, adding further appeal for families. Additional Information The property is leasehold, held on a 999-year lease from 27 March 1939, with a current ground rent of £5 per annum, and the freehold can reportedly be purchased for approximately £500. The property falls under Salford Local Authority and is in Council Tax Band C, with an annual council tax charge of £2,180. The Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) rating is C, and the home has a total floor area of 70.3m² (756.70 ft²). Heating is provided by a combi boiler. The street is publicly maintained and adopted, with Salford City Council responsible for upkeep. The electrical system was fully rewired in July 2021. Externally, the property benefits from a driveway providing parking for one vehicle. The property also benefits from a utility room and a spacious and well built garden house in the rear yard, suitable for storage or multipurpose use. Salford is a popular residential area located close to Manchester City Centre and the University of Salford, creating consistent demand for shared accommodation. The area benefits from good transport links, local shops, schools and amenities, with convenient access to Manchester, Prestwich and the wider motorway network. A vacant HMO investment offering immediate letting potential with scope to reconfigure and increase income. Don't miss out! results.summary: This three bedroom semi-detached house in Swinton, is offered for sale with no onward chain and provides practical accommodation, suited to first-time buyers and families. The ground floor includes two reception rooms. The front reception room features a bay window and laminated flooring, providing a defined living area. To the rear, an open-plan living/dining room enjoys a garden view and direct access to the garden via sliding and patio doors, creating a flexible space for everyday use and entertaining. The separate kitchen is positioned conveniently to serve the dining area. Upstairs, there are three bedrooms: two doubles, one of which benefits from built-in wardrobes, and a single bedroom that may suit use as a child’s room or study. The bathroom is fitted with a corner bath with shower. Externally, the property includes a lovely rear garden which benefits a summerhouse with electric and heating, perfect for a home office or hobbies. Parking is also available to the gated, front driveway. Location: The house is located in Swinton, within reach of local amenities including shops, supermarkets and services in Swinton town centre. Nearby primary and secondary schools make the area a suitable choice for families. The home is conveniently located with great public transport links nearby. Swinton Train station is within walking distance, providing services towards Manchester city centre, with typical journey times of around 15–20 minutes, and onward connections across Greater Manchester and beyond. Bus routes operate through the area, offering further options for commuting and accessing surrounding districts such as Salford and Eccles. IMPORTANT NOTE TO POTENTIAL PURCHASERS & TENANTS: We endeavour to make our particulars accurate and reliable, however, they do not constitute or form part of an offer or any contract and none is to be relied upon as statements of representation or fact. The services, systems and appliances listed in this specification have not been tested by us and no guarantee as to their operating ability or efficiency is given. All photographs and measurements have been taken as a guide only and are not precise. Floor plans where included are not to scale and accuracy is not guaranteed. If you require clarification or further information on any points, please contact us, especially if you are traveling some distance to view. POTENTIAL PURCHASERS: Fixtures and fittings other than those mentioned are to be agreed with the seller. POTENTIAL TENANTS: All properties are available for a minimum length of time, with the exception of short term accommodation. Please contact the branch for details. A security deposit of at least one month’s rent is required. Rent is to be paid one month in advance. It is the tenant’s responsibility to insure any personal possessions. Payment of all utilities including water rates or metered supply and Council Tax is the responsibility of the tenant in most cases. SWT260146/2 Living Room 3.7m x 3.6m The front reception room serves as a separate living room. There is a bay window allowing plenty of natural light in, after just recently being re-plastered and decorated with light grey paint and laminated flooring. Open Plan Lounge / Diner 5.97m x 5.7m A spacious open plan living / dining room. with a set of sliding doors and patio doors to access the garden, painted decoration, and laminated flooring throughout. Kitchen 5.61m x 2.3m A fully fitted kitchen with freestanding appliances such as; fridge / freezer, under the counter freezer, washing machine, and integrated oven and hob. W/C Guest toilet and sink with UPVC double glazed window. Bedroom 1 3.73m x 3.52m A double bedroom benefitting a bay window and fitted wardrobes with sliding doors. Bedroom 2 2.45m x 3.52m A second double bedroom with space for freestanding furniture. Bedroom 3 2.2m x 2.36m The third bedroom is a single, ideal as a child's room or even a home office. Bathroom 2.43m x 2.28m A white three piece suite to include a corner bath with shower over and glass shower screen. With tiled walls and vinyl flooring. Here you will also find the gas combi boiler. External The front of the home has a gated, paved driveway and low maintenance front garden. The garden at the rear benefits a paved patio area and steps up onto the lawn. There is a wooden outbuilding with electric heating and lighting, ideal as a summerhouse or home office! With a separate part used for storing garden tools. results.summary: Jordan Fishwick are pleased to have for sale this exquisite two bedroom apartment found on the second floor of the Quebec building, Salford. The property comprises of a welcoming entrance hall leading to all rooms, open plan lounge with a balcony, kitchen including integrated appliances, two double bedrooms with the master including an en-suite, a modern family sized bathroom. Funding in place but works on the EWS-1 are yet to start. Mortgage buyers welcome but need to check with their provider first. The Building - Situated in a prime location, the Quebec Building offers easy access to local amenities, including shops, restaurants, and public transport links, making it an excellent choice for those who appreciate the convenience of city living. This apartment is not just a place to live; it is a lifestyle choice that combines modern living with the charm of Salford. Whether you are a first-time buyer or looking to invest, this property presents a wonderful opportunity to own a piece of this thriving community. Do not miss the chance to make this delightful apartment your new home. We are inviting mortgage buyers due to the most recent announcement by the 6 big lenders advising they are starting to lend on buildings over 18m without and EWS1. Please take advice from mortgage lender or speak to branch to discuss*. Kitchen - 2.17 x 2.58 (7'1" x 8'5") - Range of wall and base units with complimentary kitchen worktop, integrated oven and hob with extractor fan, fridge / freezer, spot lighting, shuttered storage cupboards, laminate flooring. Lounge - 5.65 x 4.45 (18'6" x 14'7") - Open plan lounge, laminate flooring, double glazed UPVC window, access to the balcony via double glazed UPVC door, spot lighting, T.V access point, electrical heater. Bedroom One - 2.87 x 4.34 (9'4" x 14'2") - Spacious bedroom, with dressing area as you enter, fitted carpets, spot lighting, electrical heater, two double glazed UPVC windows, access to the en-suite. En-Suite - 1.59 x 2.39 (5'2" x 7'10") - Enclosed glass shower cubicle, rain attachment with mixer, fitted mirror and storage cabinet, heated towel rail, low level W.C, hand wash basin, part tiled. Bedroom Two - 4.22 x 3.78 (13'10" x 12'4") - Spacious bedroom, with dressing area as you enter, fitted carpets, spot lighting, electrical heater, two double glazed UPVC windows. Bathroom - 2.14 x 2.39 (7'0" x 7'10") - Part tiled bathroom, glass shower screen, rain attachment with mixer, fitted mirror and storage cabinet, heated towel rail, low level W.C, hand wash basin, heated towel rail. Externally - Balcony accessed through lounge. Additional Information - Lease - 250 years from 2004 Ground rent: £250 per annum Service charge: £4,504.00 Council tax band - D EPC Rating - C Agents

results.summary: Hunters are delighted to present this spacious and well presented three bedroom semi detached family home, offered on a no chain basis and tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac on the ever popular Greenway in Alkrington. Boasting a single storey rear extension, this superb property offers generous living space ideal for a growing family. Upon entering through the porch, you are welcomed by a bright and inviting hallway that leads into a large lounge featuring a bay window that floods the space with natural light. French doors open into a second generously sized reception room, currently used as a sitting/dining area, with further French doors providing direct access to the rear garden. A third set of French doors leads into a versatile study, while the ground floor is completed by a well appointed kitchen and a convenient downstairs WC. Upstairs, the property offers three well proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. Externally, there is a driveway providing off road parking for a few cars and a beautifully maintained rear lawned garden that must be seen to be fully appreciated, and a generous integral single garage, providing excellent storage options. Please note, the second garage is not included. Alkrington is one of Middleton’s most desirable and well established residential areas, offering a wide range of amenities including reputable schools, local shops, cafes, and supermarkets. For those who enjoy the outdoors, Alkrington Woods and Heaton Park are just a short distance away, offering scenic walking routes. Commuters will appreciate the excellent transport links, with easy access to the M60 and M62 motorways, as well as regular bus and train services providing quick connections to Manchester city centre, which is just a short drive away. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this fantastic home and location have to offer. results.summary: A Perfect Start: Two-Bedroom Mid-Terrace with No Onward Chain Located on a quiet, sought-after residential street, Charles Street presents a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers looking to secure a move-in-ready home in the heart of Swinton. Offered with the significant advantage of no onward chain, this property is ideal for those seeking a straightforward and efficient move. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a small, practical hallway that opens into a bright and airy lounge, perfect for relaxing after a long day. The lounge flows naturally into a spacious dining room, creating a versatile living space that feels both open and connected. The modern kitchen is situated off the dining area the owners have created an inviting open-plan feel that allows for easy socializing while cooking. The kitchen itself is well-appointed with a contemporary finish and includes a built-in integrated oven and hob. Venturing to the first floor, the property continues to offer generous proportions with two good-sized bedrooms, both providing ample space for storage and furnishings. Serving the bedrooms is a modern family bathroom featuring a clean, stylish suite. The loft has also been converted having heating and electric with velux window making it and ideal space for an office/study room. The location is a major draw for this property. Situated within a vibrant community, you are within walking distance of Swinton Square, which offers a variety of supermarkets, including Morrisons, as well as local cafes and high-street shops. For commuters, the transport links are exceptional; both Moorside and Swinton Railway Stations are nearby, providing direct access to Manchester City Centre, while the A580 (East Lancs Road) and the M60/M61 motorway network are just a short drive away. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the green spaces of Victoria Park are also within easy reach, making this an incredibly well-rounded place to call home. results.summary: A striking collection of luxurious penthouses with breathtaking views and uplifted specification at Vista River Gardens. Description Vista River Gardens is a striking new 55-storey contemporary tower positioned along the tranquil banks of the River Irwell at Trinity Island, dramatically elevated above a series of exposed architectural columns. Crowning this landmark development is an exclusive collection of premium penthouse residences arranged across two levels on the 53rd and 54th floors, offering exceptional far-reaching views and a rare sense of elevated living. Each penthouse at Vista River Gardens has been thoughtfully designed with both relaxation and entertaining in mind. Expansive open-plan layouts and floor-to-ceiling windows flood the reception areas and bedrooms with natural light while framing the impressive city and river outlooks. The residences benefit from an enhanced specification throughout, including air conditioning, electric roller blinds for effortless light control, and elegant herringbone flooring that adds warmth and sophistication. The kitchens seamlessly blend contemporary design with exceptional functionality. Featuring statement kitchen islands and upgraded premium appliances, every element has been carefully considered to deliver both style and practicality, creating the perfect setting for cooking, dining, and socialising. The bathrooms are finished with sleek, contemporary fittings and a refined palette of premium materials, creating a private sanctuary where luxury, comfort, and design come together. Set within the historic Castlefield Conservation Area, the development thoughtfully integrates nature into its surroundings. Residents will enjoy access to 1.6 acres of beautifully landscaped riverside parkland, while the nearby St John’s neighbourhood offers a vibrant mix of green spaces, culture, enterprise, and innovation. True to the developer’s reputation for luxury living, Vista River Gardens offers an extensive collection of resident amenities arranged across four dedicated floors, designed to promote wellbeing and enrich everyday living. Highlights include The Wellness Deck with a fully equipped fitness space and climbing wall, The Green & Screen featuring a putting green and outdoor cinema, Urban Tails dog spa, and The Flume Lounge & Kitchen, among many other thoughtfully curated spaces. Viewings are strictly by appointment only, please contact Savills for further details. Location Neighbouring is St John's Culture & Enterprise Quarter, a flagship innovation district, a £1bn ecosystem driving over 10,100 new jobs in tech, media and creative enterprise. With more than 560,000 sq.ft of workspace and a 3,000 strong digital workforce already in place, it's at the forefront of the city's future economy. Within 0.8 miles is Spinningfields, Manchester's central business district and world class hub & leisure district that has been a cornerstone to the city's success, supporting over 20,000 employee's across legal, finance and professional services across 4.5 million sq.ft of premium mixed use development that contributes over £1 billion annually to Manchester's economy. The District is also home to globally renowned restaurants such as The Ivy, Sexy Fish and Tattu. Manchester continues to shine for its excellence in education, with five universities attracting 116,000 new students per annum and a graduate retention rate of 51%, second to only London. Square Footage: 1,652 sq ft Leasehold with approximately 990 years remaining. results.summary: Offered for sale by auction, this mixed-use leasehold property is conveniently located close to Heaton Park and the Metrolink tram stop. The property comprises a ground floor commercial unit, currently operating as a burger shop, with a self-contained apartment arranged over two upper floors and accessed via a separate entrance. The residential accommodation includes a kitchen-diner and three bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom. The apartment is in need of full renovation, offering strong potential to add value. Due to the layout, the property may be suitable for HMO use, subject to council approval and licensing. Ideal for investors. This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Lounge - Bright and spacious living room with a Juliet balcony overlooking the communal grounds. Feature fire with fitted electric fire. TV and telephone points. Two ceiling lights. Fitted carpets, raised electric power sockets. Partially double glazed doors lead onto a separate kitchen. Kitchen - Fully fitted kitchen with tiled floor. Stainless steel sink with mono block lever tap. Built-in oven, ceramic hob with extractor hood and fitted integrated dishwasher, fridge, freezer and under pelmet lighting. Bedroom - A bright and spacious double bedroom, benefiting from a walk-in wardrobe, with plenty of hanging and storage space. Ceiling lights, TV and phone point. Shower Room - Fully tiled and fitted with suite comprising of walk-in shower, WC, vanity unit with sink and mirror above. results.summary: 49th floor one bedroom apartment in Manchester's new sought after address, Vista River Gardens! Description Savills are delighted to present this stunning 49th floor, one bedroom apartment. Briefly, the apartment comprises of a sleek and modern sizeable open plan living, kitchen and dining area. Benefitting from exquisite views, the apartment enjoys floods of natural sunlight. The bedroom is a sizeable double, benefitting from fitted wardrobes. The primary bathroom is a three piece suite, finished to the same high standard, completing the apartment. True to the developer’s reputation for luxury living, the building features an extensive range of resident amenities spread across four floors, carefully crafted to promote wellbeing and enhance the lifestyle of its residents. Among the standout amenities are The Wellness Deck, which includes a fitness space and climbing wall, The Green & Screen with a putting green and outdoor cinema, the Urban Tails dog spa, and The Flume Lounge & Kitchen, just to name a few! Brand new, having never been lived in previously, this is an exceptional opportunity to reside in one of Manchester's newest, and most sought after luxury addresses. EWS1 form available with an A1 rating, completed September 2025. Council tax band not yet available. Please enquire with local authority for further information. Location Vista River Gardens sits in an enviable location benefitting from all Manchester has to offer. Deansgate tram & train links are a mere 0.6m away. The M602 is also only 1.1m distance allowing vehicles easy access in and out of the city centre. Whilst Deansgate offers a host of independent bars, restaurants and shopping (0.7m), Regent Road retail park is also situated nearby (0.3m) with a large Sainsbury`s, TK Maxx, Boots, and much more on offer.
